title: UGC Copywriter & Creative Concepter (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Social Heaven Studios UG (haftungsbeschränkt)
description_html:
Social Heaven, part of trafficdesign | 100 % remote möglich, oder aus unseren Büros in Köln und Hamburg | Vollzeit | ab sofort

Aufgaben

#deinestelle 🚀

UGC Ads in 18 Tagen, über 800 Stück im Monat, für DTC-Brands aus Beauty, Food, Supplements, Fashion und Health. Zwischen Kundenbriefing und fertigem Ad liegt eine Menge Organisation, Gespür und Qualitätsgefühl. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Du bist die Person, die ein Kundenbriefing in konkrete Content-Ideen übersetzt, aus über 900 Creatorn die richtigen heraussucht, sie briefst, durch die Produktion begleitest und am Ende entscheidest, was gut genug ist. Und du bist die Person, mit der unsere Kund:innen sprechen, wenn es um genau diesen Content geht.

#deineaufgaben

🔥 Research & Angles: Du gräbst dich in Produkt, Zielgruppe, Reviews und Wettbewerb ein und holst genau die Sätze heraus, die deine Zielgruppe selbst benutzt. Daraus baust du Angles, die den Nerv treffen. Pro Brand, pro Funnel-Stufe, pro Plattform.

🔥 Hooks & Scripting: Dein Kerngeschäft. Du schreibst Hooks in Serie, testest Varianten gegeneinander und baust daraus Skripte für UGC Ads, Street Interviews und Advertorials. Sprechbar statt werblich, so klar, dass ein Creator sie ohne Rückfragen umsetzen kann, so offen, dass seine Persönlichkeit erhalten bleibt.

🔥 Ad Concepts: Du denkst nicht in einzelnen Texten, sondern in Konzepten. Format, Ablauf, Bildidee, Textebene, Call-to-Action. Von der ersten Sekunde bis zum Payoff steht alles auf dem Papier, bevor jemand die Kamera anmacht.

🔥 Creator-Auswahl: Beim Schreiben weißt du schon, wer es sagen soll. Du wählst aus unserem Pool die Creator aus, die zur Marke, zur Zielgruppe und zu deinem Angle passen. Typ, Sprache, Branche, Glaubwürdigkeit, alles muss stimmen. Wenn niemand passt, sourct ihr gezielt nach.

🔥 Qualitätssicherung: Du sichtest, was reinkommt, und prüfst es gegen dein Konzept. Sitzt die Hook, trägt der Text, passt Aussage und Markenfit, ist die Compliance sauber. Was dein Okay hat, geht zur Kundin.

🔥 Kundenkommunikation: Du präsentierst deine Konzepte selbst, holst Feedback ein und ordnest es ein, steuerst Freigaben und Textschleifen und sagst auch mal begründet Nein, wenn eine Änderung die Ad schwächer macht. Aus Ergebnissen und Kundenzielen leitest du die nächste Welle ab.

🔥 Creative Data: Du schaust dir an, welche Hook gehalten hat, welcher Satz den Scroll gestoppt hat und welches Format gelaufen ist. Die Learnings landen direkt im nächsten Skript. Testing-Logik statt Bauchgefühl.

Qualifikation

#wasdumitbringst

🤝 Erfahrung im Schreiben für Social: UGC Ads, Performance Copy, Content-Konzeption oder Redaktion, gerne aus Agentur, DTC-Brand oder Creator-Umfeld

🤝 Du kannst schreiben, und zwar viel. Hooks in Serie statt eine perfekte Zeile, Skripte, die gesprochen funktionieren, Briefings, die niemand nachfragen muss

🤝 Du triffst Tonalitäten: die eine Marke klingt nach bester Freundin, die nächste nach Arzt. Beides kriegst du hin, ohne dass es aufgesetzt wirkt

🤝 Du weißt, was eine Ad verkauft und was nur schön ist. Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR und CPA sind für dich Arbeitsmaterial, nicht Reporting-Deko

🤝 Konzeptstärke: du denkst über den Text hinaus in Format, Ablauf und Bildidee

🤝 Ein gutes Auge für Menschen: du erkennst, welcher Creator deine Worte glaubwürdig trägt

🤝 Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kund:innen, auch wenn Feedback mal unbequem ist, und die Fähigkeit, deine Textentscheidungen zu begründen

🤝 Du nimmst Korrekturen nicht persönlich und trennst berechtigtes Feedback von Geschmacksfragen

🤝 Struktur und Eigenverantwortung, gerade im Remote-Setup, und Verlässlichkeit bei Deadlines, weil hinter dir Creator und Editing warten

🤝 Offenheit für AI-Tools in Recherche und Ideation, mit dem Anspruch, dass die finale Zeile von dir kommt

🤝 Perfektes Deutsch und gutes Englisch

🤝 Du findest dich in unseren Werten wieder: Kundenbegeisterung, Authentizität, Qualitätsversprechen, Zuverlässigkeit und ein freundschaftliches Miteinander

Benefits

#partoftrafficdesign🩵

Social Heaven ist Teil von trafficdesign, einer der etablierten Online-Marketing-Agenturen in Köln und Hamburg mit über 70 Kolleg:innen.

Für dich heißt das: Du arbeitest in einem kleinen, schnellen, remote-first Team mit kurzen Wegen und viel Gestaltungsraum. Gleichzeitig hast du die Struktur einer großen Agentur im Rücken. Media Buyer, die dir sagen, wie deine Creatives wirklich performt haben. Analytics und Account Management, die du nicht selbst aufbauen musst. Zwei Büros, in die du kommen kannst, wenn du Lust auf Menschen hast. Weiterbildungsbudget, Coaching und ein Benefit-Paket, das du als kleine Content-Agentur sonst nicht bekommst. Und Karrierewege, die nicht an der Grenze einer Zehn-Personen-Firma enden.

Marke eigenständig, Ressourcen groß. Das ist der Deal 🤝

#benefits

Über die Gruppe bekommst du das volle trafficdesign Paket:

Remote Work, 100 % oder hybrid aus Köln und Hamburg

Deine persönliche Entwicklung steht bei uns im Vordergrund 🫵 (Coachings, Weiterbildungsbudget und jährliche Entwicklungsgespräch in denen es nur um dich geht💜)

Regelmäßige Teamevents, Messen 🪩

Workation möglich 🏝️ (und zwar nicht nur auf dem Papier)

Hardware nach deiner Wahl, Essenszuschuss, Jobticket, Urban Sports Club, uvm.

Zwei Büros mit (Dach)-Terrasse ☀️

Dogs are welcome 🐶

  1. Bewerbung per Join ✍️ Lebenslauf reicht, ein paar Ads, die du konzipiert hast, freuen uns extra.
  2. Wir telefonieren kurz für den 1st Check "was suchst du und was suchen wir" 🔎
  3. Wir lernen uns danach in einem fachlicheren Video-Call noch besser kennen ✨
  4. Du bekommst eine kleine Konzeptaufgabe oder kommst zum Probetag, damit wir beide wissen, ob es passt 🚀
  5. Dann nur noch den Vertrag und das Onboarding 🫶

title: Data Analyst (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at METYCLE
description_html:
ABOUT US

METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability
We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production.
And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.
  • Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured.
  • Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation.
  • Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured.
  • Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, and other teams to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate them into meaningful analytical questions and solutions. Communicate effectively across different levels and functions, from discussing detailed data questions with technical teams to presenting clear insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear documentation for datasets, transformations, metrics, and data lineage using dbt Docs or similar tools, and contribute to practical standards for SQL, data modelling, testing, and visualisation.
  • Automation & AI: Identify manual or inefficient analytical workflows and improve them through automation, modern data tooling, and AI-assisted analysis - using AI to accelerate data exploration, querying, documentation, and reporting while maintaining a strong understanding of and control over the underlying data.


YOUR PROFILE

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Business Analytics, or a closely related analytical role, with a track record of turning complex business questions and raw data into reliable analysis, actionable insights, and business decisions
  • Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes, define meaningful metrics, challenge assumptions, and work confidently with imperfect or incomplete data
  • Independent, structured, and pragmatic, with a strong sense of ownership. You are equally comfortable working with business stakeholders and engineers, communicate clearly across different levels and functions, and can bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You are also genuinely curious about AI-assisted analytics and modern cloud data workflows, while maintaining full control of and understanding of the underlying data
  • Strong business understanding and analytical curiosity, with the ability to quickly grasp the essentials of a complex, finance-driven business, understand how the underlying processes work, and translate business needs into meaningful analytical questions. Experience with financials, commodity trading, finance analytics, or accounting is a strong advantage
  • Strong SQL skills with experience working with complex datasets, data transformations, joins, aggregations, window functions, and analytical data models
  • Proven experience working with modern Data Warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or similar, including building and maintaining clean, reliable datasets for analysis and reporting
  • Experience with modern analytics engineering practices and tools such as dbt, including data modelling, automated data quality tests, documentation, and data lineage
  • Strong experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar), with a focus on building clear, performant dashboards and enabling self-service analytics


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities
  • You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location
  • We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment


CONTACT

Discover more about METYCLE:

About us | LinkedIn

We look forward to receiving your application. Irene Prinz is happy to answer any questions you may have: +49 152 34 62 72 85.

title: Automation Engineer - PLC / Plant Control (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at METYCLE
description_html:
ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
  • Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities
  • You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location
  • We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment

description_html:
Unser Projekt für Dich:

moebel.de ist eines der führenden Online-Shoppingportale für Möbel und Einrichtung in Europa. Unser neues Projekt Piqit ist ein KI-gestützter Shopping-Assistant, der die Art und Weise verändert, wie Menschen online Produkte finden und kaufen.

Piqit berät den Nutzer interaktiv und findet passende Produkte aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten, vergleicht Preise über zahlreiche Shops hinweg und führt direkt zum passenden Anbieter – von Wein und Werkzeug über Elektronik und Haushaltsgeräte bis hin zu Beauty, Schmuck und Möbeln. 

Dafür suchen wir dich als Product Manager AI Search (m/w/d).


Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben

  • Vom ersten Tag an mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du verantwortest die Antwortqualität von Piqit, unserem KI-gestützten Shopping-Assistant, der aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten das passende Produkt findet – und zwar von der ersten Beobachtung bis zur ausgerollten Änderung.
  • Qualität heißt hier nicht Treffermenge, sondern Antwort: Du prüfst, ob Piqit verstanden hat, worum es geht, ob die vorgeschlagenen Produkte wirklich die richtigen sind und ob die Einordnung dazu trägt.
  • Ursachenforschung ist deine Kerndisziplin: Wenn eine Antwort nicht überzeugt, unterscheidest du sicher, ob die passenden Produkte gar nicht gefunden wurden, ob in den Produktdaten ein Attribut fehlt oder falsch belegt ist oder ob das Modell aus guten Daten etwas Falsches gemacht hat.
  • Du kennst die Eigenheiten von Sprachmodellen: stark bei Absicht, Nuance und Sprache, unzuverlässig bei exakten Zahlen, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität – und dabei immer überzeugend klingend. Genau dieses Gespür bringst du in jede Entscheidung ein.
  • Hands-on statt Konzeptpapier: Prompt-Sets, Hints und Regeln schreibst und rollst du selbst aus, Attribute und Facetten schärfst du selbst nach, Testsets baust du selbst – und wiederkehrende Handgriffe automatisierst du weg, gern KI-gestützt.
  • Du misst, was wirkt: Einzelfälle sind kein Beleg, dieselbe Anfrage kann zweimal unterschiedlich beantwortet werden. Du prüfst gegen eine feste Sammlung von Testanfragen und bewertest die Veränderung über alle hinweg. Der Weg von der Beobachtung zur Änderung ist kurz, vieles geht am selben Tag live.
  • Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Data und Engineering: Für Themen, die tiefer in der Pipeline liegen, arbeitest du eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen. Was du nicht selbst umsetzen kannst, übersetzt du in fundierte Anforderungen an Engineering und Data – mit Beispielen, Zahlen und einer klaren Priorisierung.
  • Neue Shops, neue Daten: Du begleitest die Partneranbindung, prüfst, was die Antwortqualität wirklich trägt, und sagst klar, wenn ein Sortiment noch nicht live gehen sollte.
  • Kategorie-Management ist dein Schlüssel: Kategorien, Attribute und Facetten entscheiden mit darüber, was der Assistent über ein Produkt überhaupt weiß – und weil semantische Ähnlichkeit allein nicht reicht, sobald es um Maße, Kompatibilität oder harte Grenzen geht, legst du hier selbst mit Hand an.


Deine Stärken

  • Du kannst relevante Berufserfahrung im E-Commerce, im Produktmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle vorweisen, in der du ein Produkt wirklich vorangetrieben und nicht nur begleitet hast
  • Eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität zeichnet dich aus – du willst Dinge selbst bauen und live sehen, statt sie zu delegieren und nachzuhalten
  • Mit Sprachmodellen hast du über gelegentliches Prompting hinaus praktisch gearbeitet: Du hast Prompts systematisch verbessert, Ergebnisse verglichen und weißt, wo diese Systeme kippen – idealerweise mit Lösungen wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Gemini
  • Durch dein Gespür für Nutzerbedürfnisse erkennst du, was hinter einer Anfrage steckt und wann eine Antwort nur oberflächlich passt
  • Du überzeugst durch eine selbstständige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und hast Lust, deine Ideen aktiv im Team einzubringen
  • Technisch bist du anschlussfähig: Du liest eine API-Antwort, verstehst eine Datenstruktur und hast keine Scheu vor SQL – programmieren musst du nicht, selbst anpacken schon
  • Erfahrung mit Retrieval, Ranking oder semantischer Suche sowie mit dem Aufbau von Evals und Testsets ist wünschenswert
  • Kenntnisse in Produktdaten, Feeds, Taxonomien und Attributsystemen sind von Vorteil, ebenso Erfahrung mit Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n, Make oder Python sowie mit MCP- und Agenten-Anbindungen
  • Deutsch beherrschst du verhandlungssicher, gute Englischkenntnisse bringst du mit


Unser Angebot

Dein Tagesablauf gehört dir
Arbeite dann, wenn du am produktivsten bist. Ob Früh- oder Spätaufsteher: Bei uns passt du deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel an – in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team. Zeitweise Arbeiten aus dem europäischen Ausland? Kein Problem. Dein Laptop ist dein Arbeitsplatz.

Unsere Kultur ist einmalig
Hier sitzen alle auf derselben Couch – unabhängig von Titel oder Rolle. Teamspirit leben wir digital und vor Ort, z. B. bei Gaming Nights, Workouts, Filmabenden oder Teamevents.

Viermal im Jahr treffen wir uns zur Company Week
Gemeinsam im Büro arbeiten, Projekte pushen, Pizzabende genießen und mit einer Party abschließen.

Mitten in Hamburg

title: SCADA Engineering Manager (m/f/d) – Utility Scale PV & BESS
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Greencells Gmbh
description_html:
Overview

As SCADA Engineering Manager, you take technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems for our utility-scale PV and BESS projects. You act as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and external suppliers such as Gantner or meteocontrol — ensuring these systems are correctly specified, integrated, tested and commissioned.

This role combines strong technical understanding with coordination and stakeholder management: you translate between grid operator requirements, customer expectations, supplier solutions and EPC project realities. 
Most importantly, when a plant reaches commissioning, you ensure SCADA, PPC and communication systems work reliably — rather than becoming the project's last unresolved interface.


Your mission

  • Technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems
  • Supplier management — coordinating SCADA/PPC providers (e.g. Gantner, meteocontrol) and holding them accountable for correct specification, integration and delivery
  • Acting as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and suppliers
  • Testing & commissioning oversight for SCADA, PPC and communication systems
  • Engineering & project coordination across the full plant lifecycle


Your profile

  • Degree in electrical engineering, automation engineering, control engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
  • Several years of professional experience in SCADA, industrial automation, power plant control, renewable energy, or grid integration
  • Experience with utility-scale PV, BESS, substations, or other power generation assets highly desirable
  • Good understanding of SCADA architectures, industrial communication networks, and plant control systems
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, OPC UA or comparable
  • Understanding of active power, reactive power, voltage and grid control concepts is an advantage
  • Experience working with grid operators, utilities, or grid compliance requirements highly desirable
  • Proven track record coordinating external technical suppliers and managing complex system interfaces
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across hardware, software and communication systems
  • Confident communicator with engineers, customers, suppliers and grid operators
  • Structured working style and a strong ownership mentality — you drive technical topics until resolved
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites, suppliers or customers
  • Driving licence category B
  • Fluent English; German language skills strongly preferred
  • A responsible, proactive and solution-oriented approach to work, with the ability to apply professional expertise effectively in day-to-day activities
  • A commitment to respectful, trusting collaboration and mutual support within the team


What we offer

 

  • Work in a growing, international company with a start-up mindset
  • A workplace in a central location in Saarbrücken with good transport links
  • An open and friendly working atmosphere
  • Flexitime scheme with core working hours
  • Company sports programme (Hansefit)
  • Subsidised parking in the city centre or a travel allowance for public transport
  • JobRad

description_html:
Deine Rolle bei Karriere Tutor

Karriere Tutor steht für moderne, praxisnahe Weiterbildung und Umschulung – und für eine Lernkultur, die Menschen stark macht. Du möchtest mit deinem Know-how und deiner Persönlichkeit etwas bewegen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und begleite unsere Teilnehmenden in ihrer persönlichen Entwicklung. 

So sieht dein Tag bei uns aus:

Als Team Lead für Weiterbildungsangebote im Team AI und Data Science AI verantwortest du die Durchführung und inhaltliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Kurse im Team KI und Data Science. 

Dafür führst du ein Team von Dozierenden, bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für Kursproduktionen und -inhalte für unser Produktmanagement und sorgst mit deinem Team für eine qualitativ hochwertige und didaktisch wertvolle Vermittlung der Inhalte an unsere Teilnehmenden.    

  • Du führst und entwickelst dein Team von Dozierenden im Bereich Data & AI und gibst fachliche Orientierung für die Weiterentwicklung der Kurse.  
  • Du gibst als Subject Matter Expert wichtigen Input zur Weiterentwicklung des Kursportfolios deines Themenfelds ein, hilfst uns inhaltliche Trends zu erkennen und relevante Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen zu entwickeln.  
  • Du beobachtest aktuelle Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning und Analytics und leitest daraus relevante Themen, Technologien und Qualifizierungsangebote für unser Portfolio ab.  
  • Du stellst die fachliche Qualität unserer Weiterbildungen sicher und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Inhalte, Lernziele, Konzepte und Formate kontinuierlich weiter.  
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Dozierenden und Fachexpert:innen zusammen und unterstützt sie bei der fachlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Kurse.  
  • Du stellst die adäquate qualitative und quantitative Besetzung deines Teams mit internen und externen Dozierenden sicher und steuerst gemeinsam mit unserem Dispositions-Team ihren Einsatz in Lehre und Kursproduktionen. 
  • Du analysierst Markt-, Kunden- und Teilnehmendenfeedback und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um bestehende Angebote zu optimieren und neue Angebote zu entwickeln.  
Kurz: Du sorgst dafür, dass unser AI und Data Science Weiterbildungsportfolio fachlich relevant, technologisch aktuell und wirtschaftlich erfolgreich bleibt. 


Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit:

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Mathematik, Wirtschaftsinformatik bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.  
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Data & AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld.  
  • Führungserfahrung oder Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung von Teams bzw. Netzwerken.  
  • Fundiertes Verständnis aktueller Entwicklungen im Bereich Data & AI sowie ein gutes Gespür dafür, welche Technologien und Kompetenzen für Arbeitsmarkt und Weiterbildung relevant sind.  
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Weiterentwicklung oder Steuerung von Weiterbildungs-, Trainings- oder Qualifizierungsangeboten.  
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Dozierenden, Fachexpert:innen und unterschiedlichen internen Stakeholdern.  
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, Verlässlichkeit, Empathie und eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.  
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. 
Das wäre ein Plus:
  • Erfahrung in der Erwachsenenbildung oder beruflichen Weiterbildung.  
  • AEVO-Schein (AdA), Train the Trainer oder eine vergleichbare berufspädagogische Qualifikation.  
  • Erfahrung mit Python, Data Analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning, BI oder generativer AI.  


Unsere Benefits für dich

  • Work & Travel: Verbinde deinen Job mit Reisen – bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr remote aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub: Ob du die Welt bereisen, Abenteuer erleben oder dich einfach erholen möchtest – wir geben dir den Freiraum dafür.
  • Weiterbildung: Lebenslanges Lernen gehört bei uns dazu! Wir fördern dich bei deiner Karriereplanung.
  • Wellhub: Für mehr Gesundheit, Wohlbefinden und Bewegung – mit digitalen Tools und Fitnessangeboten vor Ort, ganz flexibel nach deinem Bedarf.
  • Team Spirit: Wir setzen auf ein Miteinander – flache Hierarchien, Duz-Kultur und regelmäßige Teamtreffen.
  • Zukunftsorientiert: Wir sichern dich ab – von betrieblicher Altersvorsorge bis zum Kindergartenzuschuss. Wir denken heute schon an übermorgen für dich und deine Familie!
  • Corporate Benefits: Auf der Suche nach dem nächsten Deal? Bei uns bekommst du zahlreiche Vergünstigungen und exklusive Angebote.


Hier wirst du gebraucht

Wir freuen uns auf deine Unterstützung an unseren Umschulungsstandorten in Augsburg, Braunschweig, Bremen, Köln, Leipzig und München. Teile uns deinen bevorzugten Arbeitsort einfach im Rahmen deiner Bewerbung mit!

title: Senior Associate (m/w/d) Restrukturierung mit Schwerpunkt Finanzierung
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Brl
description_html:
Es kommt drauf an - wo und mit wem man arbeitet!

Vollzeit | unbefristet | zu sofort

Wenn Finanzierung, Strategie und Recht zusammenfinden müssen, kommt es auf Menschen an, die den Überblick behalten. 

Wir beraten unsere Mandanten mit klarem Blick für das Machbare: von der frühzeitigen Krisenerkennung und der Restrukturierung von Finanzierungen über StaRUG-Strukturen bis hin zu komplexen M&A- und Carve-out-Prozessen. Dabei verbinden wir rechtliche Präzision mit wirtschaftlichem Verständnis und arbeiten eng mit unseren Experten aus Corporate, M&A, Steuerberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung zusammen. 
Für unser wachsendes Restrukturierungsteam suchen wir Sie als Senior Associate (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Finanzierung. Sie arbeiten unmittelbar mit Mandanten und Finanzierungspartnern, übernehmen früh Verantwortung und gestalten anspruchsvolle Lösungen aktiv mit. 


Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie beraten Unternehmen, Gesellschafter und Finanzierungspartner in Krisen- und Restrukturierungssituationen.
  • Sie begleitenvorinsolvenzliche Restrukturierungen, insbesondere StaRUG-Verfahren.
  • Sie gestalten und verhandeln Sanierungsvereinbarungen sowie Kredit- und Finanzierungsverträge.
  • Sie begleiten M&A-Transaktionen mit finanzierungsrechtlichem Schwerpunkt.
  • Sie übernehmen eigene Mandatsverantwortung und gestalten den weiteren Ausbau unseres Restrukturierungsbereichs aktiv mit.


Ihr Profil

  • Volljurist/in mit überdurchschnittlichen Examina
  • Min. vier Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Restrukturierungs- oder Insolvenzberatung
  • Unternehmerisches und wirtschaftliches Verständnis
  • Strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Teamplayer mit sicherem Auftreten und Freude am Mandantenkontakt
  • Ausgeprägte Affinität zu digitalen Arbeitsweisen und neuen Technologien sowie die Bereitschaft, deren Einsatz in der Mandatsarbeit weiterzuentwickeln
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse


Warum wir?

  • Mandate mit Wirkung: Sie arbeiten an Situationen, in denen rechtliche Entscheidungen unmittelbare wirtschaftliche Bedeutung haben – und helfen Mandanten, wieder Handlungsspielraum zu gewinnen. 
  • Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit: Rechtsanwälte, Wirtschaftsprüfer, Steuerberater und Restrukturierungsexperten sitzen bei uns unter einem Dach. Das ermöglicht kurze Wege und Lösungen, die rechtliche, finanzielle und steuerliche Perspektiven verbinden. 
  • Technologie im Wandel: KI und Digitalisierung verändern auch die Arbeit in der Restrukturierung. Bei BRL erleben Sie diese Entwicklung nicht nur bei unseren Mandanten, sondern gestalten sie in einer multidisziplinären Kanzlei mit. 
  • Verantwortung und Entwicklung: Sie erhalten früh direkten Mandantenkontakt, übernehmen Verantwortung für eigene Aufgabenbereiche und entwickeln sich in einem strategisch wachsenden Beratungsfeld weiter. 
  • Ein Team auf Augenhöhe: Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, kommunizieren offen und unterstützen einander auch dann, wenn Mandate komplex und zeitkritisch werden.
  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten. 
  • Zusätzliche Vorteile: Individuelle Weiterbildung, Mobilitätszuschüsse. 
  • Vergütung:  Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung mit leistungsbezogener Komponente, Entwicklungsperspektive und Beteiligung an geworbenen Mandaten.

About the role

We're looking for two Payment Support Coordinators to join our Expert Services & Operations (ES&O) team on a short-term contract basis. You'll work directly on our linguist payment queue, helping to clear a backlog of payment requests and restoring a reliable, responsive experience for our global network of expert linguists.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You'll be triaging, investigating, and resolving payment issues across multiple systems, working closely with our existing coordinators and escalating to finance and engineering where needed.

What you'll be doing

  • Triaging and responding to incoming payment support tickets in Jira, prioritising by urgency and issue type

  • Investigating payment failures, discrepancies, and delays across the Lilt platform, Tipalti, Salesforce, and third-party processors (PayPal, Payoneer)

  • Resolving common issues including: Tipalti profile corrections, 2FA resets, banking detail mismatches, and manual offline payment (OPM) re-logging

  • Communicating clearly and empathetically with linguists to gather information and provide timely updates

  • Escalating technical breakages (e.g. platform stats sync issues) and rate discrepancies to the relevant internal teams

  • Maintaining accurate ticket notes and contributing to weekly reporting on queue volume and SLA adherence

What we're looking for

  • Experience in a payments, finance operations, or customer/vendor support role

  • Comfortable working across multiple systems simultaneously (Jira, Salesforce, or similar)

  • Detail-oriented with strong written communication skills — you'll be dealing with complex, sometimes sensitive payment disputes

  • Able to work independently, manage a high-volume queue, and know when to escalate

  • Experience with Tipalti or international payment platforms is a strong plus

  • Fluency in English required; additional languages are a bonus given our global linguist community

What to expect

This is a contract role. You'll be joining a small, collaborative ES&O team and will have clear ownership of a defined portion of the queue from day one.

LILT's mission is to make the world's information available to everyone, no matter the language they speak. Join our global community who thrive on innovation and excellence. description_html:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🧩 Context of the role

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

  • Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

  • Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

🎯 Your mission

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

  • Business Strategy

    • Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan

    • Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)

    • Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

  • Sales & Account Manager Planning

    • Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

    • Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

  • Performance monitoring & Steering

    • Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

    • Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

    • Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either:

  • Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

  • Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

  • Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

  • Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

  • Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company

Business sense:

  • At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

  • Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

Communication and presence:

  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

  • Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

  • Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

  • Great written and oral structure and communication

  • Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

  • Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area

Nice to have

  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

  • Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

  • Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

description_html:
🩺 Why Prévenir

Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in the Île-de-France region.

Our ambition is to rethink occupational health in order to improve its impact on employees’ lives and the experience of healthcare professionals, leveraging Alan’s technology.

Our first medical centre has opened at 117 Quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris, and this is just the beginning!

👉 To learn more about what day-to-day life is like at Prévenir, click here.

⭐ The role, concretely

Are you excited about building, structuring and scaling HR operations in a company that's just getting started? You will join Prévenir at a very early stage and help build the foundations of our People and administrative operations as the company scales. This role is particularly suited to someone who has already experienced a fast-growth environment, whether in a start-up, scale-up or during a 0-to-100 journey.

We're in the early chapters: this isn't about running existing processes — it's about creating them from scratch so they hold up at much larger scale. The role brings a product mindset to People operations, where every key moment of the employee experience is carefully designed, with a constant focus on simplicity and automation. You'll work closely with Lucie, who makes the final calls depending on topic complexity and supports you as you grow into autonomy.

Your time is split between:

  • Employee journey: onboarding, probation-period tracking, setting up and running performance reviews, feedback processes, and monitoring team engagement.

  • Documentation & operational efficiency: writing clear, user-centric documentation, spotting friction, simplifying or automating recurring processes. You leverage AI to multiply the impact of your work.

  • People admin: leave and absence management, payroll back-and-forth, contracting and employee administrative follow-up, onboarding formalities and affiliations (health/provident insurance, occupational health), GDPR compliance.

  • Operational finance: expense reports, preparing and sending accounting documents to Impulsa, preparing routine filings (including VAT).

Over time, this person will take ownership of payroll management in coordination with our accounting partner, with training and support.

👤 The profile we're looking for

Essential:

  • At least 5-6 years of experience in People Ops, very hands-on, and comfortable with admin topics (e.g., managing the relationship with an accounting firm)

  • Previous experience in a fast-scaling company, start-up or scale-up, ideally having helped build or scale People processes during a period of significant growth.

  • Business curiosity: genuinely interested in what's happening on the business side, and able to connect your work to where the company is heading

  • Versatility across People and Corporate/Admin topics, with a strong People focus

  • Rigour and rock-solid attention to detail

  • Autonomy: you don't wait to be told there's a problem — you spot it, bring a solution, and know when to loop someone in on the tricky ones

  • Demonstrated interest in automating and improving recurring processes, and genuine enthusiasm for AI

  • Comfort interacting with a wide range of stakeholders, including senior profiles when needed

  • Fluent English (written and spoken) to interact with the Alan team

  • Based in Paris or the Île-de-France region, with the ability to work onsite regularly, ideally three days per week or more.

Ideally:

  • Experience in MedTech or in a start-up / scale-up

  • Sensitivity to the medical world (professional or personal)

  • Note: a 100% Occupational Health background may not be the right cultural fit, but worth testing

🙏 What we offer

  • Location: 117 Quai de Valmy, Paris 10th, in a brand-new centre designed to support high-quality practice

  • Base salary: between €53,000 and €61,000 gross per year, depending on experience and level

  • Profit-sharing scheme: 10%, in line with Prévenir’s framework

  • Benefits: daily transport costs covered, company restaurant, RTT days and regular team events

Skills

  • Versatility and stellar execution - You are comfortable with context switching while maintaining impact.

  • Organization and autonomy - You are well-served in missions requiring precision and reliability.

  • Crisp thinking and clear communication - You communicate effectively and concisely .

Languages

  • Fluency in spoken and written English.

  • Fluency in spoken and written French.

Background

description_html:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role:

The Notion EMEA Recruiting team acts as trusted business partners who craft a thorough, inclusive, and curated interviewing experience. We believe hiring exceptional talent, at the right time, is the best path forward to achieve our company’s ambitious goals.

We’re looking for a Go-to-Market Recruiter to support our growth across key Go-to-Market (GTM) teams in EMEA, with an emphasis on Sales. In this role, you'll help shape our recruiting strategy, manage full-cycle hiring efforts, and ensure a delightful yet rigorous hiring process.

This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Serve as a trusted recruiting partner to leaders across the GTM org, owning the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing through successful close

  • Design and implement creative sourcing strategies to attract diverse top talent across EMEA markets

  • Ensure scalable and structured hiring plans with consistent evaluation processes while creating thoughtful candidate experiences

  • Partner with cross-functional teams including Total Rewards, People Operations, and People Partners to drive holistic talent strategies

  • Leverage AI tools, to innovate recruiting processes and provide data-driven insights on market conditions

  • Champion and scale best practices while thoughtfully adapting for regional nuances

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in high-growth, technical, GTM functions

  • Fluency in French and English

  • Proven track record of identifying, qualifying, and closing exceptional talent across various levels

  • Experience coaching and advising hiring managers through our recruiting process while keeping talent density as a priority

  • Ability to build diverse candidate pipelines and guide hiring managers in creating inclusive teams

  • Outstanding communication, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills with a commitment to delivering high-quality recruiting experiences

  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments

Nice to Haves:

  • Passionate about leveraging technology and AI to transform recruiting processes

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy.

#LI-Onsite

A Note on AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: IT Specialist / Administrator (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at ZeinPharma Germany GmbH
description_html:
Wer wir sind:

Seit über 25 Jahren steht ZEINpharma für Mikronährstoffe in Premiumqualität. Heute umfasst das Produktportfolio über 170 Produkte – von Vitaminen, Mineralstoffen und Enzymen bis hin zu patentierten Spezialwirkstoffen. Als Familienunternehmen legen wir Wert auf erlesene Inhaltsstoffe, höchste Reinheit und die Formulierung unserer Produkte auf Basis neuster wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse. Entwicklung und Herstellung erfolgen aus einer Hand an unserem Unternehmensstandort im hessischen Nauheim - für Kunden in Deutschland und weltweit.

Was uns auszeichnet: Der Anspruch, Dinge neu und anders zu denken - kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum für persönliche Gestaltung. ‚Jeder Tag ist Deiner‘ ist hierbei kein einfaches Versprechen. Wir suchen kreative, kluge und erfahrene Persönlichkeiten, die mit uns das tägliche ‚Plus‘ an Gesundheit weitergeben – an Menschen, die das Besondere suchen und für die ein gesundes und erfülltes Leben besonders wichtig ist**.**

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle:

Du baust unsere Inhouse-IT mit auf – und genau das macht diese Rolle besonders. Du baust unsere IT-Infrastruktur von einer gut gewachsenen Umgebung zu einer zukunftssicheren, strukturierten Landschaft weiter. Kein Konzern-Ticketsystem, kein Abteilungsdenken – sondern echtes Ownership über Netzwerk, Server, Cloud und Endgeräte.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Administration und Weiterentwicklung unserer Netzwerk- und Firewall-Infrastruktur (Fortinet FortiGate, VLANs, VPN, Segmentierung)
  • Betrieb und Optimierung unserer Windows-Server-Umgebung inkl. Active Directory, DNS, DHCP und Virtualisierung (Hyper-V / VMware)
  • Administration unseres Microsoft 365 Tenants – Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Entra ID und Intune
  • Standardisiertes Endgeräte-Management für Windows und iOS inkl. Onboarding & Offboarding
  • Aufbau einer soliden IT-Security- und Compliance-Struktur: Berechtigungskonzept, Backup-Strategie, Dokumentation
  • Automatisierung von Routineprozessen mit PowerShell oder Python

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

  • Min. erste Erfahrung als IT System Engineer oder Administrator
  • Tiefes Know-how in mindestens zwei Bereichen: Netzwerk/Firewall, Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Virtualisierung oder IT-Security
  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Fortinet FortiGate sowie Active Directory, DNS/DHCP und GPOs
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft 365, Entra ID und Intune
  • Strukturierte, proaktive Arbeitsweise – du wartest nicht auf Tickets, du erkennst Handlungsbedarf selbst
  • Nice-to-have: Erfahrung im Produktionsumfeld (OT/IT), Zertifizierungen (Fortinet, Microsoft) oder Kenntnisse in ISO 27001 / NIS2

Benefits

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

  • Die Chance, unsere IT-Infrastruktur als Teil unseres Tech & Innovations-Teams von Grund auf zu prägen
  • Moderne Umgebung, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen, die du dir selbst aussuchst
  • 50 % Mitarbeiterrabatt auf alle ZEINpharma-Produkte sowie Zugang zu Corporate Benefits
  • Hochmoderne, neue Büroräume mit ergonomischer, höhenverstellbarer Ausstattung
  • Mitarbeiterparkplätze direkt vor der Tür und kostenlose Getränke

Du möchtest Teil unseres Teams werden?

Wolltest du schon immer den Gesundheitsmarkt von morgen mitgestalten?Und Du legst Wert auf ein innovatives und kreatives Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und viel Raum für die persönliche Entwicklung?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Bei uns zählen Leidenschaft für die Gesundheit, für das Besondere, unternehmerisches Denken und die Lust, Dinge wirklich voranzubringen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Senior Software Architect (C#/Angular/AI First) - GovTech SaaS company
description_html:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

Our client is a leading GovTech SaaS company that has spent more than two decades helping public-sector and education organizations modernize critical operations through technology.

By combining deep domain expertise with modern cloud platforms, AI-enabled workflows, and a customer-first mindset, the company delivers solutions that simplify complex HR, compliance, and workforce management processes. Their products support the entire employee lifecycle—from hiring and onboarding to development, retention, and retirement—allowing organizations to better serve their employees and communities.

The engineering organization embraces an AI-first approach, leveraging modern development practices and intelligent tooling to accelerate innovation, improve software quality, and increase developer productivity.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Architect to lead the design and evolution of scalable, secure, and cloud-native SaaS platforms.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on defining architectural standards, guiding engineering teams, and delivering high-quality solutions using modern .NET technologies, distributed systems, and cloud-native patterns.

As part of an AI-first engineering culture, you will actively leverage AI-assisted development tools, reusable workflows, and agentic approaches to streamline development, automate engineering tasks, and improve delivery velocity across teams.

Responsibilities

  • Design and evolve scalable, secure, and highly available SaaS applications using C#, .NET, and cloud-native architectures.

  • Define technical architecture and engineering standards across multiple products and teams.

  • Lead the adoption of microservices, domain-driven design (DDD), CQRS, event-driven systems, and API-first approaches.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, and fellow Architects to deliver reliable and maintainable solutions.

  • Mentor senior engineers and provide technical guidance on architecture, design decisions, and implementation strategies.

  • Drive improvements in system performance, scalability, observability, and security.

  • Promote engineering best practices, including code quality, automated testing, and operational excellence.

  • Champion AI-assisted software development by integrating modern AI tools and workflows into everyday engineering practices.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years as a Software Architect, Principal Engineer, or technical leader.

  • Expert-level experience with C#, .NET Core, Entity Framework, and Angular (v16+).

  • Strong experience designing enterprise SaaS platforms using microservices, DDD, CQRS, and event-driven architectures.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS (preferred) or Azure and cloud-native application design.

  • Solid knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases (DocumentDB is a plus).

  • Proven ability to lead technical initiatives, mentor engineers, and drive architectural decisions across teams.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Daily experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to improve engineering productivity.

  • Familiarity with modern AI concepts and workflows, including LLMs, RAG, MCP, and agentic development practices.

Nice to have

  • Experience with GraphQL APIs.

  • Kubernetes and container orchestration.

  • Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.

  • Observability platforms including CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic.

  • Platform Engineering experience.

  • AI agent development or autonomous workflow orchestration.

  • AWS Solutions Architect certification.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Workflow Squad, you'll design, build, and operate product capabilities that help Cloudbeds support increasingly complex hospitality operations. This is primarily a backend product engineering role, working in PHP and Java across services, APIs, data, and event-driven systems, with occasional frontend contributions when needed.

You'll take ownership of work from technical design through production, balancing near-term product delivery with the reliability and maintainability of the broader platform. You'll work closely with product and engineering partners to solve ambiguous problems and deliver simple, dependable experiences for our customers.

Our Workflow Squad:

The Workflow Squad builds product and platform capabilities that coordinate business processes across Cloudbeds products and services. The team works across existing systems to create flexible, reliable experiences that support a wide range of customer needs. You'll join a hands-on, product-minded group that values pragmatic architecture, clear ownership, maintainable code, and strong collaboration across Product, Design, Infrastructure, Security, and Engineering. The squad works AI-first. Claude Code is the default starting point for implementation, and the engineer who ships a change owns it in review and in production.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Design, build, and operate customer-facing backend services and product capabilities primarily in PHP and Java, with focused frontend contributions when needed
  • Build reliable APIs, data models, integrations, asynchronous processes, and event-driven services using PostgreSQL, Kafka, REST, and gRPC
  • Own changes end-to-end across application code, service boundaries, infrastructure, and deployment configuration, from technical design through production operation
  • Work AI-first, using Claude Code as the default starting point for implementation, and hold what it produces to the same review, testing, and production bar as code you write by hand
  • Improve scalability, resilience, performance, security, and maintainability across distributed systems that support customer-critical operations
  • Own observability, automated testing, release quality, production support, and incident response as part of the team's on-call rotation
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Infrastructure, Security, and other engineering teams to turn ambiguous requirements into pragmatic, reliable product solutions
  • Contribute as a senior individual contributor through architecture decisions, code reviews, pair programming, documentation, mentoring, and continuous improvement of engineering practices

What Sets You Up for Success:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating production applications, with strong proficiency in PHP and/or Java
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including maintainable architecture, automated testing, debugging, performance, security, and operational reliability
  • Solid understanding of API design, relational data modeling, PostgreSQL, distributed systems, and asynchronous or event-driven architecture
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar messaging and streaming systems, REST, gRPC, and service integrations
  • Experience owning cloud-native delivery and operations, including Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, CI/CD, observability, and production incident response
  • A track record of owning complex work end-to-end, navigating ambiguity, and making pragmatic technical trade-offs
  • Comfort working in a polyglot codebase and making focused contributions outside your primary backend stack when the product requires it
  • Strong product sense and customer empathy, with the ability to translate business needs into simple, reliable product experiences
  • Hands-on experience shipping production code with AI coding agents
  • Business-level English fluency, with strong written communication and collaboration skills in a remote, globally distributed team

Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $130,000 and $175,000 USD. Please note that we maintain high flexibility, and packages above this range will be considered. (The salary is only for US-based candidates).

We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it.   • Evaluate where AI practically enhances a workflow versus where it serves as a distraction, advising clients with realistic, grounded expectations.

  • Support the rollout of new tools and workflows, ensuring adoption is rooted in process design and change management.

  • Design enablement materials that ensure new technology implementations effectively connect to and support the intended operating model.

  • Support complex engagement scoping and conduct diagnostic assessments for value capture, implementation readiness, and adoption strategy.

  • Contribute reusable frameworks and tools that continuously improve practice qualification and scoping.

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in management consulting or equivalent roles within enterprise technology, SaaS, or professional services.

  • Demonstrated expertise in at least two of the following areas: organizational design, operating model transformation, change management, technology enablement, process engineering, or go-to-market execution.

  • Proven track record of building structured, evidence-based arguments to effectively influence and align senior stakeholders.

  • Hands-on experience building functional AI-powered workflows, automations, and prototypes, with the ability to ship working solutions rather than just designing them.

  • Ability to rapidly scope and build a working proof of concept within the constraints of a client engagement to move skeptical stakeholders.

  • Comfort and capability working autonomously without a dedicated engineering team, knowing exactly when to build solutions independently and when to pull in additional resources.

  • Strong diagnostic mindset with a dedication to understanding root causes and broken processes before jumping to solutions.

  • Deep accountability to actual outcomes and measurable impact rather than just static deliverables.

  • Bias toward early proof, preferring to build working prototypes over producing standard roadmaps.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a forward-deployed capacity, integrating deeply alongside client engineers, product leads, and operators.

  • Experience in large-scale organizational assessments, process redesigns, or large-scale technology rollouts is highly preferred.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to work at the core of content and creative transformation engagements.

In this role, you will map existing creative workflows, redesign them, and build AI-powered pipelines that demonstrate a new operating model inside real production environments.

Building is not a differentiator in this role - it is the job. The ideal candidate comes from creative technology, production engineering, content operations, or applied AI within creative environments. You operate inside workflows, not above them.

Depending on the engagement, you may operate in a forward-deployed capacity, embedded directly within client teams and working alongside creative directors, producers, marketing technology leads, content operations teams, and engineers to redesign and ship workflows in real time.

This is not a separate program or specialization. It is an expected mode of working, requiring adaptability, hands-on execution, and close collaboration with stakeholders.

Workflow Mapping & Redesign

  • Map creative workflows end-to-end, including briefing, concepting, production, review, localization, activation, and measurement.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for automation.

  • Diagnose root causes of workflow friction, including approval delays, handoff failures, tooling gaps, and governance challenges.

AI Pipeline Development

This is the core responsibility of the role.

  • Configure and implement creative AI platforms and tools against real production requirements.

  • Integrate AI-powered workflows into existing ecosystems, including DAMs, CMS platforms, marketing technology stacks, and project management systems.

  • Build prompt architectures, agent workflows, automation layers, and quality control mechanisms that can operate reliably at production scale.

  • Develop working proofs of concept and production-ready solutions that demonstrate measurable business value.

Governance & Adoption

  • Establish governance frameworks covering brand safety, content rights management, model selection, approval workflows, compliance, and auditability.

  • Define and track success metrics, including throughput, cycle time, cost-per-asset, quality consistency, and operational efficiency.

  • Ensure knowledge transfer and long-term sustainability beyond the initial engagement.

Engagement Support & Practice Development
