title: Senior Relationship Manager (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at ICBC Frankfurt Branch
description_html:
Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) Frankfurt Branch was established in June 1999, which holds the universal bank license of Germany and is a correspondent bank for first class clearing of Euro and a member of the Target2 and SEPA of the Euro Clearing System. ICBC Frankfurt Branch is also the Euro Clearing Center of ICBC Group.

Tasks

  • Develop and expand the Bank’s corporate client portfolio by identifying and acquiring creditworthy corporate clients in Germany and international markets.
  • Conduct market and industry analysis to identify target clients, new business opportunities and potential growth areas, while building and maintaining a strong pipeline of prospective clients and new-to-bank (NTB) business.
  • Establish and maintain long-term relationships with senior management and key decision-makers of corporate clients. Develop a thorough understanding of clients’ business models, strategic priorities and financial needs and translate these into appropriate client strategies and account plans.
  • Identify and develop suitable business opportunities across corporate banking, lending, trade finance, cash management and financial markets products, working closely with relevant internal functions to structure tailored solutions.
  • Lead and coordinate the end-to-end client and business process, from initial client acquisition and needs assessment through credit assessment and approval, contract execution and implementation, in accordance with the Bank’s internal policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with Credit, Financial Markets, Compliance, Legal and Operations to ensure efficient, accurate and compliant execution of transactions and client-related activities.
  • Monitor client, industry and credit developments, identify potential risks and opportunities, and contribute to sustainable portfolio growth in line with the Bank’s business strategy and risk appetite.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in Corporate Banking, Relationship Management and/or Credit, preferably gained within a commercial or international bank in Germany.
  • Proven experience in corporate client acquisition, business development and relationship management, ideally with an established network of corporate clients in Germany.
  • Solid knowledge of corporate banking products, lending and credit processes, as well as the German corporate and financial market.
  • Strong business development, communication, negotiation and analytical skills, combined with a clear commercial and customer-oriented approach.
  • Fluent German and English, both written and spoken. Additional Chinese language skills are an advantage.
  • Strong initiative, ownership and resilience, with the ability to work independently and effectively in an international and multicultural environment.
  • High risk awareness and the ability to balance business development objectives with the Bank’s risk management framework and applicable regulatory requirements.

Benefits

  • The opportunity to work for one of the world’s largest banking groups and be part of an international financial institution with a strong global presence.
  • An international corporate banking platform in the heart of Frankfurt, Germany’s leading financial centre, with exposure to German, European and cross-border business.
  • Access to a global banking network, providing opportunities to work with colleagues, clients and business partners across Europe, China and other international markets.
  • A strong China–Europe business platform, with the opportunity to support international companies in their cross-border trade, investment and financing activities.
  • Broad corporate banking exposure, including corporate lending, trade finance, cash management, international settlement and financial markets, in close cooperation with specialised internal teams.
  • The opportunity to build and manage senior-level corporate client relationships and take an active role in developing the Bank’s corporate banking business in Germany.
  • A multicultural and international working environment, bringing together professionals with diverse backgrounds and expertise.
  • Opportunities for professional development and long-term career growth within an internationally connected banking organisation.

Please send your complete application documents including CV, cover letter (optional), salary expectations and earliest possible entry date with reference to the above mentioned job title to us.

title: Creator Manager TikTok Shop - NL (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at GENUINE Beauty GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

We’re looking for you!

TikTok Shop is changing the way people shop online – and you can be part of it from the very beginning.

GENUINE is one of Germany’s leading TikTok Shop partners, and we’re looking for a Creator Manager (m/f/d) to join our team in Cologne. You won’t just be managing lists – you’ll be responsible for the creator strategy for some of our most important brands. Your mission: build a strong creator network, develop creators strategically, and turn TikTok trends into formats that actually drive sales.

Join one of Europe’s most sought-after TikTok Shop agencies and take ownership of creator management and operational execution.

  • Brand Ownership: You manage a selection of our core brands as their dedicated point of contact – from creator strategy to performance, always keeping the brand identity in mind.
  • Trend & Format Development: You spot emerging TikTok trends early and turn them into new content formats that convert and scale.
  • Creator Coaching: You actively support our affiliate partners with hooks, trend insights, and content feedback – helping them create videos that don’t just look good, but actually sell.
  • Creator Scouting & Development: You identify promising creators, bring them on board, and build long-term partnerships instead of relying on one-off collaborations.
  • Creative Briefing: You translate brand goals into clear, actionable briefs that empower creators to produce TikTok-native content that performs.
  • TikTok Collaboration: You stay in regular contact with TikTok’s own teams, keep up with algorithm updates, and leverage new features strategically for your brands.

Your profile

  • Initial experience in influencer marketing, talent management, or social media – ideally with a focus on measurable results.
  • You’re a TikTok native: You spot trends before they peak and know how to turn them into repeatable content formats.
  • Strong understanding of TikTok hooks, social commerce, and creator content optimization – you know what makes content perform and convert.
  • Native-level Portuguese and good English skills for internal communication.

Why us?

  • Make an Impact: Flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes – your ideas don’t get stuck in endless approval rounds. They get put into action.
  • Day-One Mentality: We move fast. You’ll join an international, high-energy team where ideas don’t get stuck in meetings – they get executed.
  • Real Growth: Build expertise in some of the most in-demand areas of digital marketing right now – creators, e-commerce, and live shopping.
  • Strong Team: International, fast-paced, and open-minded – we work hard, and we make sure to have fun while doing it.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You Will Join 

 
You'll be part of our Executive Assistant team led by Claire, Executive Assistant to the CEO. The team consists of 3 Executive Assistants supporting Mirakl's most senior C-levels. Together, you'll ensure seamless operational support that empowers our executive team to focus on Mirakl's growth and strategic impact.
The team works closely together to share best practices, continuously improve processes, and drive efficiency initiatives — including through the use of AI tools.
 

What You"ll Do

Executive Support — Labs Leadership Team (CTO and Chief Data & AI Officer)

  • Coordinate and proactively manage executive business calendars (anticipate conflicts, prioritise competing demands, proactively optimize agenda with enough buffers)
  • Arrange travel end-to-end — flights, hotels, ground transport, visas — and ensure all logistics are in place well in advance of each trip
  • Prepare and process expense reports for executives when requested, in line with internal policies
  • Type, revise, edit Linkedin communications
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with absolute discretion

Labs Team Support

  • Arrange and coordinate team meetings
  • Manage and coordinate specific projects in support of the labs teams, for example: client visits in Mirakl HQ in Paris, team building lunches
  • Aid in purchase management: raise purchase orders, track invoices, and liaise with Finance to ensure timely processing
  • Liaise with HR, Finance, and IT on behalf of both departments for any operational or administrative requests (Lucca, TravelPerk, Expensya)

Event Planning & Management

  • Own end-to-end logistics for a wide range of events : internal Labs Kick-Offs, QBRs, Mirakl Makers Club, team building activities
  • Ensure all logistics associated with travel, offsite meetings, and events are fully in place well ahead of each date
  • Source and negotiate with venues, caterers, AV suppliers, and other vendors; manage event budgets and track spend
  • Manage attendee registration, invitations, RSVPs, and on-site check-in processes
  • Coordinate speaker and VIP logistics: preparation materials, rehearsals, and on-site support

What You'll Bring

Experience
  • 3–5+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, ideally within a fast-growing, international organisation
  • Proven track record in event planning and management, from intimate team offsites to large-scale conferences
  • Hands-on experience with expense and purchase management platforms (e.g. Payflows, Expensya)
Skills
  • Highly organised, with the ability to juggle multiple workstreams and rapidly shifting priorities without losing composure
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented — you anticipate needs before they become problems
  • Impeccable discretion when handling sensitive business and personnel information
  • Genuine curiosity for AI tools, with a drive to leverage them in your day-to-day work
  • Strong collaborative mindset — a true team player who elevates those around them

Tools Used

  • Google Suite
  • Slack
  • Confluence
  • TravelPerk
  • Expensya / Lucca
  • Dust

Languages

  • French: Fluent (C2 level required)
  • English: Fluent (B2 level required)

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Commercial Analytics)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Pleo
description_html:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role


Please note: applications will be open until Thursday 24th September 2026 09.00 CEST.
We will no review any applications before the closing date so everyone has equal chances to be selected. Use this time to submit a high quality application that will showcase your strengths.

 

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Growth Intelligence team at Pleo. In this role, you'll design and maintain the integration architecture and data contracts that connect our commercial and GTM data layer (the pipelines linking our CRM, billing, and customer success tooling to a central BigQuery warehouse) and be part of the team as we scale our commercial data foundations to support RevOps, Customer Success, and the AI products built on top of them. If you're excited about untangling complex, multi-system architecture and are passionate about building data foundations the whole business can trust, then this is the opportunity for you!

 

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to the Senior Manager of Growth Intelligence and work closely with the RevOps and the BAT (Business Architecture & Technology) teams to understand what commercial operations needs from data. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to keeping Pleo's commercial and GTM data trustworthy and well-governed. You’ll also partner with Analytics Engineers to ensure pipeline outputs are modelling-ready, and engage upstream with tool owners and engineering teams to push data quality and schema discipline closer to the source.

 

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines between commercial tools (HubSpot, Zuora, Vitally) and our BigQuery data warehouse.

  • Own reverse ETL flows: enrich or define data in the warehouse and push it back into operational tools like HubSpot, keeping definitions consistent across systems.

  • Implement and maintain data contracts with clear ownership, SLAs, and schema agreements between data producers (tool owners, product engineers) and data consumers (analysts, RevOps, AI tooling).

  • Partner with RevOps and the BAT team to understand operational data requirements and translate them into reliable, governed pipelines.

  • Build monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they surface in dashboards, operational reports, or downstream models.

  • Simplify integration architecture by centralising data flows through the warehouse, reducing point-to-point tool integrations and the maintenance burden that comes with them.

  • Work with Analytics Engineers to ensure pipeline outputs are structured and documented for downstream modelling.

  • Engage upstream with tool owners and engineering teams to move data quality and schema discipline closer to the source.

Our commercial data stack connects subscription billing (Zuora), CRM (HubSpot), and customer success tooling (Vitally) to a central BigQuery data warehouse. You can expect to work with the following tech stack: BigQuery, Python, HubSpot, Zuora, and Vitally plus dbt, Fivetran/Census, or Airflow depending on your background.

 

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines in a commercial or GTM data environment.

  • Strong understanding of CRM data models, APIs, and field management (HubSpot or comparable experience).

  • Hands-on experience with reverse ETL patterns: pushing warehouse-enriched or warehouse-defined data back into operational tools.

  • Extensive BigQuery experience.

  • Experience implementing data contracts in a production environment.

  • Python proficiency for pipeline development, transformation logic, and tooling.

  • Git-based workflows and CI/CD experience for data engineering code.

 

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are equally excited by deep technical work as you are by collaborating with business stakeholders.

  • You can comfortably work with a wide variety of data sources and can operate within a complex multi-system environment.

  • You truly shine at solving problems and driving alignment between GTM/commercial stakeholders.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer to work on platform matters that are one step removed from the business.

  • You have never collaborated with senior stakeholders on GTM / commercial analytics work.

  • You need a very defined roadmap and backlog to operate efficiently. You'll need to adapt to rapid changes and be part of the roadmap definition discussions in this role.

 

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Become familiar with our data ecosystem and codebase.

  • Support to drive a HubSpot reimplementation project from the data side.

  • Collaborate with Data Platform & Analytics Engineers as well as GTM teams to improve or commercial analytics efforts.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 

Show me the benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Core skills tests: An async coding exercise through our CoderPad third party platform.

  3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat with your Manager to deep dive into your technical experience and impact.

  4. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute live interview with two colleagues to assess your architecture and problem solving skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Senior Data Engineer, we received a total of 543 applications but only 15 were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • This role requires experience operating within a SaaS organisation, collaborating closely with GTM teams. It is equally important to demonstrate your technical expertise with production pipelines as it is to demonstrate your understanding and impact across commercial analytics.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We are looking for an AML Analyst to join Pleo’s Decision Intelligence team and help strengthen how we detect, prevent, monitor, and respond to fraud risk across our financial crime decisioning setup.

This is not a traditional Fraud Operations case-handling role. You will work closer to the decisioning layer: helping translate fraud patterns into rules, monitoring rule performance, supporting rule testing, reviewing alert behaviour, and making sure fraud controls remain effective, explainable, and proportionate.

You will join at an important stage as Pleo continues to mature its fraud and AML decisioning capability. The right person will help improve speed, resilience, and quality in how we create, test, deploy, monitor, and tune fraud rules.

 

What you’ll be doing

You will help operate and improve Pleo’s fraud decisioning capability, with a focus on card fraud and related financial crime risk scenarios.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the end-to-end fraud rule lifecycle: from rule proposal and analysis through testing, deployment, monitoring, tuning, and rollback.

  • Working directly in, or closely with, decisioning tools and rule engines to support fraud detection logic.

  • Analysing fraud patterns, alert trends, false positives, false negatives, and rule performance.

  • Translating FraudOps insights and stakeholder requests into clear, structured rule proposals.

  • Helping assess whether new rules or threshold changes are justified by data.

  • Monitoring post-deployment rule performance and identifying when rules need adjustment.

  • Supporting daily operational requests related to fraud controls, while ensuring changes are traceable and well documented.

  • Partnering with FraudOps, AML, Product, Engineering, Data, Compliance, and Legal to make sure decisioning changes are aligned and risk-aware.

  • Maintaining clear documentation for fraud rules, rationale, expected impact, testing outcomes, and monitoring results.

  • Helping reduce single points of failure by building repeatable processes and stronger business continuity around fraud decisioning.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for someone who combines fraud domain knowledge with practical experience working in a decisioning environment.

You should have:

  • Experience as a Fraud Analyst, Risk Analyst, Fraud Strategy Analyst, Fraud Rules Analyst, Decisioning Analyst, or similar.

  • Hands-on experience with a decisioning tool, fraud rules engine, risk platform, or internal decisioning system.

  • Experience creating, testing, monitoring, or tuning fraud rules, thresholds, scenarios, or risk logic.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data to assess rule performance and fraud patterns.

  • Good understanding of fraud typologies, especially card fraud, transaction fraud, account misuse, or payment fraud.

  • Ability to balance fraud prevention with customer impact and operational workload.

  • Experience working with false positives and understanding that good fraud controls require continuous monitoring and tuning.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain rule logic, rationale, risks, and expected outcomes clearly.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with FraudOps, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Data teams.

  • A structured mindset and appreciation for documentation, traceability, governance, and change control.

  • Fintech, banking, payments, spend management, or regulated financial services.

  • SQL or basic data analysis.

 

What success looks like

In your first 3 months, success would look like:

  • You understand Pleo’s fraud decisioning setup and can confidently support day-to-day rule operations.

  • Fraud rule requests are better structured, documented, and traceable.

  • Rule changes are supported by data, clear rationale, and expected impact.

  • Post-deployment monitoring is more consistent and visible.

  • FraudOps and DI have a stronger operating rhythm for proposing, reviewing, deploying, and tuning fraud controls.

Why join us?

This is a rare opportunity to help shape a growing decisioning function from the inside. You will not just be reviewing fraud alerts, you will help define how fraud detection logic is built, governed, monitored, and improved.

You will join a team that is building the foundations for more scalable, data-driven, and resilient financial crime decisioning. If you enjoy working at the intersection of fraud strategy, operations, data, systems, and product, this role will give you real ownership and impact.

 

Apply if this sounds like you

You are analytical, structured, curious, and comfortable challenging assumptions. You know that fraud rules are never “set and forget.” You understand the importance of balancing risk reduction, customer experience, operational workload, and governance.

Most importantly, you have worked with decisioning tools or rule-based risk systems before and want to help build a stronger fraud decisioning capability at scale.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Behavior Planning
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Aerovect
description_html:
Who We Are

AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer who can design and build best-in-class behavior planning systems for autonomous driving in structured, low-speed environments.

In this role, you'll own the design and implementation of key modules in the behavior planner — the decision-making layer that determines what the vehicle should do in complex, dynamic airside scenarios. You'll work at the intersection of mission-level goals and motion-level execution, tackling problems in multi-agent interaction modeling, rule-based and learned decision-making, and robust handling of edge cases unique to airport ground operations.

This opportunity offers a deeply technical engineer the chance to shape a market-defining enterprise product that combines autonomous vehicle technology with a robotics-as-a-service (RaaS) business model. This role reports to our Planning Tech Lead and works closely with the autonomy engineering team.

You Will

  • Develop and implement advanced behavior planning algorithms for autonomous vehicles

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure robust integration and functionality of planning systems

  • Design, write, and maintain efficient and scalable code in C++ and Python

  • Contribute to the architecture and continuous improvement of behavior planning software

  • Conduct extensive testing in simulated environments and real-world scenarios to validate and refine behavior planning algorithms

  • Analyze system performance and implement enhancements based on data and feedback

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of code, algorithms, and system designs

  • Work closely with other engineering teams to ensure seamless coordination and development

You Have

  • Proficient in modern C++ (11/14/17) and object-oriented programming

  • Skilled in Python for rapid prototyping and testing

  • Strong in debugging, profiling, and optimizing code

  • Deep understanding of behavior planning algorithms such as state machines, behavior trees, and probabilistic planning

  • Familiarity with path planning algorithms like A*, RRT, or optimization-based methods

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field

  • Minimum of 3 years of industry experience in autonomous driving, robotics, or a related field

We Prefer

  • Knowledge of state machines, behavior trees, and decision-making under uncertainty

  • Expertise in path planning algorithms such as A*, D*, and Rapidly-exploring Random Trees (RRT)

  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques, especially in the context of behavior prediction and planning

  • Experience with ROS / ROS2

  • Implementing systems that can re-plan at high frequencies to adapt to dynamic changes in the environment

  • Ensuring that behavior planning algorithms can execute with minimal latency for real-time navigation

  • Proficiency in optimization techniques and probabilistic models for making informed planning decisions under uncertainty

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Robotics, AI, Mathematics, or a related field with a focus on planning, optimization, or control theory is a plus

title: Founding Engineer - Ambient Care Startup

description_html:
Stage: Pre-seed. Location: Cambridge/London, UK. Comp: Competitive + Equity

About Subtle

Most families find out something's wrong too late: a fall, a missed check-in, a change no one noticed until it became a crisis. We're building ambient sensing for the elderly and vulnerable at home, technology that quietly looks out for the people we love without asking them to wear anything or change how they live. We're early. We're validating with real customers, building the first hardware, and looking for the person who'll help turn this from an idea into a product families can trust with something this personal.

We are building this from scratch inside Founders Factory's studio, with a dedicated pre-seed investment, hands-on studio support across product, design, talent and growth, and a six-month build programme to get from concept to a fundable, in-market product. This venture has secured a major European technology partner. The founding CEO is already in place. We are now looking for the technical other half of the founding team.


The role

You'll be our first engineering hire, working directly with the founder(s) and carrying real authority over what we build and how. It's a hands-on role that spans hardware and software, and a leadership one too, since you'll grow the team that follows you.

Responsibilities

  • Own hardware validation and bench testing end to end, and lead our manufacturing path. Whether that ends up being an outsourced partner or in-house, you're the one validating the sensor platform yourself and making sure whatever we ship has been properly tested before it reaches someone's home. This is safety-relevant, so you'd rather catch a failure on the bench than have it happen in someone's home.

  • Build the software that turns sensor data into something useful. Detection logic, alerting, and the escalation decisions that sit behind them, tested and monitored with the same rigor as the hardware.

  • Navigate the regulatory and security requirements that come with this territory. Certification requirements for embedded systems (software and hardware), and data protection for Personally Identifiable Information (PII), from day one rather than retrofitted later.

  • Grow the team. As we scale past this hire, you'll hire, mentor and lead the engineers who join under you.

What we're looking for

Must have's

  • Early-stage hardware experience. You've taken a hardware product from 0 to 1 in a startup environment, and you're comfortable spanning embedded systems and software.

  • Experience using AI to accelerate how you work, across engineering, prototyping, and the day-to-day operations of running a startup.

  • Experience leading or building a small engineering team, or clearly ready to step into that.

  • A proactive, evidence-first way of working. You're comfortable with ambiguity, and comfortable being told (including by yourself) that a result doesn't hold up.

  • Experience with regulatory, security, or compliance requirements in health tech, medical devices, or another safety- and privacy-regulated space. You understand that building for vulnerable people and their data changes what "done" means.

  • Lead vendor and manufacturing negotiations, securing the right partners, terms, and production capabilities to bring the product to market.

  • Any direct experience taking a regulated product through certification (CE/UKCA, FDA, or equivalent) is considered a major plus.

Die IONOS Cloud betreibt eigene Rechenzentren und eigene Hardware. Was wir beschaffen, steht oft schon wenige Wochen später als Server, Storage oder GPU im Rack und fängt die Workloads unserer Kundschaft ab. Deshalb suchen wir nicht einfach nur eine klassische Einkaufsfachkraft, sondern einen echten Cloud Procurement Profi (w/m/d). Eine Person, die den technologischen Bedarf versteht, bevor er überhaupt entsteht: Du hast die Kapazitätslage unserer Flotte genau im Blick, analysierst datengestützt, was wann bestellt werden muss, verhandelst die besten Konditionen und pflegst unsere Supplier-Beziehungen auditsicher.

Aufgabenbereich

  • Procurement-Expertise: Einschlägige Praxis im strategischen IT-Einkauf, idealerweise mit starkem Fokus auf Rechenzentrums-Hardware und nicht ausschließlich auf Software oder Lizenzen.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Du kannst Stücklisten lesen, Konfigurationen bewerten und auf Augenhöhe mit dem Engineering über technische Anforderungen diskutieren. Ein tiefes Verständnis von Cloud-Lizenz- und Verbrauchsmodellen (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) setzen wir voraus.
  • Data-Driven & Zahlenaffinität: Du arbeitest datengestützt mit Auslastungs- und Bedarfszahlen. Deinen Erfolg misst du an Einsparungen (Savings), Prozessdurchlaufzeiten, Liefertreue und Contract Compliance.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick: Du glänzt durch nachweisbare Erfolge in der Steuerung komplexer Ausschreibungen (RFPs) und in anspruchsvollen Verhandlungen.
  • Compliance-Mindset: Du weißt genau, warum ein transparentes Supplier-Register essenziell ist. Die partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit der Informationssicherheit und dem Datenschutz ist für dich selbstverständlich.
  • Sprachkompetenz: Deine Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau.

Das ist ein Plus

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Suppliern aus dem RZ-Umfeld (OEMs, Distributoren, Systemhäuser).
  • Berührungspunkte mit gängigen Compliance-Rahmenwerken (BSI C5, ISO 27001, IT-Grundschutz, TISAX, DORA).
  • Branchenwissen im öffentlichen Sektor oder im Umgang mit stark regulierten Zielgruppen.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit.
  • An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke.
  • Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung. Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte.
  • Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops. Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

Über IONOS

IONOS ist der führende europäische Digitalisierungs-Partner für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU). IONOS hat mehr als sechs Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden und ist mit einer weltweit verfügbaren Plattform in 18 Märkten in Europa und Nordamerika aktiv. Mit seinen Web Presence & Productivity-Angeboten agiert das Unternehmen als “One-Stop-Shop" für alle Digitalisierungs-Bedürfnisse - von Domains und Webhosting über klassische Website-Builder und Do-It-Yourself-Lösungen, von E-Commerce bis zu Online-Marketing-Tools. Darüber hinaus bietet IONOS Cloud-Lösungen für Firmen, die im Zuge der Weiterentwicklung ihres Geschäfts in die Cloud wechseln möchten.

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

title: Creative Designer (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Neolymp
description_html:
Dich begeistern Creatives, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern skalieren? Du willst von grafischer Seite unmittelbar daran mitwirken, dass ein Onlineshop wächst – und in den Zahlen sehen, was dein Hook, dein Static, dein Banner bewegt? Dann bist du bei NEOLYMP richtig. Wir skalieren unseren Shop, und ein großer Teil davon entscheidet sich im Creative. Genau da sitzt du: als Creative Designer:in, der oder die aus Design- und Grafiksicht maßgeblich an unserer Performance mitwirkt.

Wer wir sind

NEOLYMP ist eine Berliner Fitnessmarke, gegründet 2018. Wir entwickeln innovatives Fitnessequipment und ganzheitliche Trainingskonzepte für zu Hause – vom durchdachten Home-Gym-Equipment bis hin zu Online-Kursen, die Training, Motivation und Alltag zusammenbringen. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir über Amazon und unseren eigenen Onlineshop.

Content ist bei uns der Motor: Wir bauen unsere Inhouse-Creative-Produktion konsequent aus – mit echten Shootings, einem Creator-Netzwerk und KI-gestützten Workflows. Unser Grafikteam wächst, und wir suchen jemanden, der das gesamte visuelle Spektrum abdeckt.

Warum diese Rolle

  • Du bist Teil der Performance: Deine Creatives laufen im Paid-Marketing und entscheiden mit, wie profitabel wir skalieren. Du siehst in den Zahlen, welcher Hook funktioniert, welches Static klickt – und drehst mit jeder Iteration an einem Hebel, der direkt auf Umsatz wirkt.
  • Alles aus einer Hand: Video-Creatives, Statics, Social-Content, Shop-Banner, Produktbilder – du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für alles Visuelle und siehst deine Arbeit überall: in Ads, im Feed, im Shop.
  • Bestes Rohmaterial: Du arbeitest mit Content aus echten Shootings und von echten Creatorn – kein Stockmaterial, sondern Persönlichkeiten und Produkte, die du in Szene setzt.
  • Grafikteam statt Einzelkämpfer: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen, die Grafik, Content und Creator verantworten, und eng mit Marketing und Performance zusammen.
  • KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Ersatz: Du nutzt KI-Tools, um schneller zu Varianten und Ideen zu kommen – und entscheidest als Designer:in, was davon gut ist.

Aufgaben

Performance Creatives

  • Du schneidest Video-Creatives für Meta, TikTok und weitere Paid-Kanäle – vom Rohmaterial aus Shootings und Creator-Content bis zum fertigen Ad, inklusive Hook-Varianten, Untertiteln und Sound.
  • Du gestaltest Static Ads, die in Sekunden verstanden werden, und entwickelst sie auf Basis der Performance-Daten iterativ weiter.
  • Du setzt Briefings aus dem Performance-Team um und bringst eigene Ideen für Formate, Hooks und Varianten ein.

Social Media & Organic Content

  • Du produzierst Grafiken, Reels-Schnitte, Story-Formate und Carousels für unsere organischen Kanäle – konsistent im Look, angepasst an jede Plattform.
  • Du entwickelst Templates, die dem Content-Team schnelle, markenkonforme Veröffentlichungen ermöglichen.

Shop, Amazon & Brand

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für alle Bannerbilder, Kampagnen-Visuals und Shopbilder – von Landingpage-Headern.
  • Du hältst unser visuelles Erscheinungsbild über alle Kanäle konsistent und entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.

Produktion & Workflow

  • Du integrierst KI-Tools in deinen Workflow – für Ideation, Bildvarianten, Freisteller, Übersetzungen oder Schnitt-Unterstützung – und teilst mit dem Team, was funktioniert.

Qualifikation

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall

  • Schnitterfahrung: Du beherrschst Videoschnitt sicher – Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve oder vergleichbar – und lieferst aus Rohmaterial eigenständig fertige, plattformgerechte Video-Creatives inklusive Schnittrhythmus, Text-Overlays, Untertiteln und Sound.
  • Bildbearbeitung & Grafik: Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma oder vergleichbare Tools sind dein Handwerkszeug. Freisteller, Retusche, Composings, Layouts und saubere Exportformate für Web, Social und Amazon gehen dir leicht von der Hand.
  • Ein Portfolio, das beides zeigt – Video und Static.

Das ist uns außerdem wichtig

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Grafik-, Motion- oder Creative Designer:in, idealerweise im E-Commerce, D2C oder in einer Performance-Agentur.
  • Ein Verständnis dafür, was Performance Creatives von schönen Grafiken unterscheidet: Hook, Klarheit, Tempo, Lesbarkeit auf dem Handy.
  • Gespür für Social-Plattformen: Du weißt, wie Content auf TikTok, Instagram und Pinterest aussehen muss, um nicht weggewischt zu werden.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du jonglierst mehrere Aufträge parallel, hältst Deadlines und behältst den Überblick über Formate, Versionen und Assets.

Das zählt für uns am meisten

  • Lust darauf, wirklich das ganze visuelle Spektrum zu bespielen, Neugier auf neue Tools und die Motivation, mit der Rolle und dem Team zu wachsen. Das Handwerk setzen wir voraus – für alles darüber hinaus ist uns Drive wichtiger als das perfekte Profil.

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit KI-Tools in der Bild- oder Videoproduktion (z. B. Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs).
  • Fotografie- oder Kamera-Erfahrung für Shootings.
  • Kenntnisse in Shopify (Bildformate, Theme-Assets) oder Amazon-Bildrichtlinien.
  • Erfahrung im Fitness- oder Sport-Umfeld.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt unter „außerdem wichtig“? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns interessiert dein Portfolio und wie du denkst – nicht, ob du jede Zeile abhaken kannst.

Benefits

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest überwiegend remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die dir eine eigenverantwortliche Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags ermöglichen. Zu Shootings triffst du das Team vor Ort – der Rest läuft von dort, wo du am besten arbeitest.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Neben moderner Hardware und den Tools, die du brauchst, erhältst du eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug sowie ein persönliches Educational Budget für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
  • Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst das visuelle Erscheinungsbild einer wachsenden Marke und gestaltest den Aufbau unserer Inhouse-Creative-Produktion aktiv mit – inklusive KI-basierter Workflows.
  • Dynamisches Startup-Umfeld: Freue dich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – und darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Kontakt: Josephine Steuer

Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt uns stärker macht. Deshalb heißen wir alle Bewerbenden willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung. Bei uns gibt es keinen Dresscode und wir duzen uns einfach. Der Einfachheit halber verwenden wir im Text eine Sprachform, schließen damit aber ausdrücklich alle Menschen ein.

Aufgaben

  • Category & Positioning: Du schärfst die Positionierung von Product Mining und entwickelst daraus eine klare Markt- und Buyer-Story.
  • Commercial Story: Du verbindest Customer Value, Business Impact und Produktnutzen zu einer belastbaren C-Level-Argumentation.
  • Sales Enablement: Du entwickelst die Narratives, Proof Points und Enablement-Bausteine, die Enterprise Sales wirksamer und konsistenter machen.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Enterprise Software, Product Marketing, Commercial Strategy, Product Strategy, Value Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle
  • Nachweislich starke Positionierungs- und Messaging-Kompetenz für erklärungsbedürftige B2B-Produkte
  • Ausgeprägtes kommerzielles Denken und ein gutes Verständnis für C-Level Buying Decisions
  • Erfahrung damit, neue Produkte, Kategorien oder Problemräume im Markt verständlich und differenziert zu verankern
  • Enge, glaubwürdige Zusammenarbeit mit Sales und Product; du kannst challengen, priorisieren und komplexe Themen radikal vereinfachen
  • AI-native Arbeitsweise sowie sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch
  • Erfahrung mit Industrie, Manufacturing oder komplexen technischen B2B-Märkten ist ein Plus. Entscheidend ist aber die Fähigkeit, sich schnell in industrielle Wertschöpfung, Produkte und Buying Center einzuarbeiten.

Benefits

  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Direkter Einfluss auf Positionierung und Kategorieentwicklung einer B2B-Software mit echtem Marktpotenzial
  • Kurze Wege: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit CEO, CPO, Product & Enterprise Sales
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Modernes Umfeld: Büro im Münchner Werksviertel (House of Communication), moderne Ausstattung und internationale, diverse Teams
  • Entwicklung & Kultur: Regelmäßiges Feedback, flache Hierarchien und kollaborative Zusammenarbeit
  • Plus: Spendit Card, Urban Sports Club oder EGYM Wellpass, kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee & Obst sowie Team- und Office-Events

title: Data & Strategy Operations Specialist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Better Collective A/S
description_html:
Hey there, Future Data & Strategy Operations Specialist @ Better Collective! 👋

Our mission is to be the world’s leading digital sports media company, making sports entertainment more engaging and transparent for fans worldwide.

Better Collective is the team behind industry-leading sports and betting media brands such as Action Network, HLTV, RotoGrinders, The Nation Network, BolaVIP, and Playmaker, reaching 400M+ monthly visits across digital, social, mobile, and CTV platforms.

With FanReach at the core of our audience strategy, we’re transforming first-party data into a powerful monetization engine for advertisers. We connect high-intent sports fans with performance-focused brands through advanced data, contextual targeting, and scalable audience solutions.

We’re now looking for a Data & Strategy Operations Specialist to help stand up, implement, and operationalize our Data Management Platform (DMP) and contextual targeting solutions from the ground up.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role, ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys building systems from scratch, and knows how to turn complex data into commercial outcomes.

You’ll report directly to Alex Payne and work closely with Commercial, Product, Tech, and Data partners across regions.

This role is for you if…

You’re a builder at heart. You’ve helped implement or operate a DMP, CDP, or audience data solution before, and you’re excited by the challenge of taking something from zero to one.

You’re equally comfortable going deep into technical details and stepping back to think strategically about monetization, scale, and market impact. You can work independently, but you know when and how to collaborate to move things forward.

Sports experience is a plus, curiosity, ownership, and execution mindset are essential.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Here are some of the ways you’ll contribute to our mission:

  • Own the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and optimization of Better Collective’s DMP and contextual targeting solutions.

  • Act as the primary point of contact with our DMP vendor and the internal go-to expert for audience data capabilities.

  • Build, analyze, and scale audience segments using first-party, contextual, and partner data.

  • Profile and segment advertising inventory to ensure scale, brand suitability, and commercial viability.

  • Collaborate with data providers and aggregators to strengthen and expand our data offering.

  • Work closely with Sales, RevOps, Media Planning, and Account Management teams to support data-driven media sales.

  • Help translate data and platform capabilities into clear commercial insights for internal stakeholders.

  • Support FanReach product development by providing actionable insights and operational feedback.

  • Ensure data practices align with privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.).

The Ideal Profile: Is This You?

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Operations / RevOps, specifically within a Publisher, Media House, or AdTech Sell-Side environment (Manager / Senior level).

  • Mandatory, hands-on experience operating a DMP (Data Management Platform)—including audience segmentation, taxonomy creation, and activation to power ad inventory and sales.

  • Strong balance of technical data proficiency and commercial revenue strategy—able to translate complex data infrastructure into actionable, monetization-driven insights for Sales and RevOps teams.

  • Proven understanding of first-party data, identity resolution, contextual targeting, and brand suitability frameworks across digital ad channels.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical data engineers and commercial stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working independently in an individual contributor (IC) role, owning end-to-end outcomes in fast-paced environments.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in sports media, iGaming, or performance advertising.

  • Global or multi-market experience (US, LATAM, EMEA).

  • Familiarity with programmatic, direct sales, and data licensing models.

  • Experience working with Google Ad Manager (GAM), with a solid understanding of analytics and the ability to apply data insights (e.g., Google Analytics, campaign and performance metrics) to inform strategy and decision-making.

Meet Your Manager & Team

You’ll report to Alex Payne, a strategic leader focused on building scalable, data-driven commercial products. Alex values ownership, clarity, and collaboration, and will partner closely with you while giving you the autonomy to build and execute.

You’ll also collaborate with Commercial leadership, Product, Tech, and Data teams across regions.

Your Growth & Our Culture

  • Collaborative environment with open communication and trust.

  • Global exposure, working with teams across regions and markets.

  • Real ownership & impact: your work directly shapes how the brand shows up every day.

  • Room to grow, with support for learning and new challenges.

  • Balance & flexibility, whenever possible.

  • A culture that’s informal, supportive, and fun, expect memes, good coffee, and lively Slack channels.

Ready to Join?

We’re excited to learn more about you!

Our Interview Process:

  1. Application review by our People team

  2. Intro interview with Talent / People

  3. Interview with the Hiring Manager

  4. Final conversation

  5. Offer & reference checks

Our process may vary slightly by role or location, but we’ll keep you informed at every step.

title: VP Engineering (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Synagen GmbH
description_html:
About Synagen

Synagen builds AI copilots for oncologists. We help clinical teams bring together patient information, medical evidence and treatment options when decisions matter most.

We are physicians, AI researchers and engineers working closely with hospitals and oncology care providers. Our goal is to turn advances in AI into reliable software that makes a measurable difference in everyday cancer care.

Tasks

The role

As VP Engineering, you will build and lead the engineering organisation behind our AI platform. Your mandate is clear: turn product requirements and validated AI concepts into reliable, scalable and maintainable software. You will own engineering delivery, architecture, technical quality and engineering culture while remaining hands-on where it matters.

What you'll do

  • Build and lead the engineering organisation.
  • Own engineering delivery from architecture through production.
  • Turn product requirements into pragmatic technical designs and execution plans.
  • Raise the bar for quality, reliability, security and engineering excellence.
  • Stay hands-on through architecture, critical implementation and technical leadership.

Requirements

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and leading engineering teams in a fast-moving product company.
  • A track record of taking products from prototype to production while scaling engineering teams, processes and technical foundations from early-stage through growth.
  • Strong engineering judgement across modern Python-based backend systems, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems and AI-enabled products.
  • Experience building and operating LLM or agentic systems in production, including evaluation, guardrails and failure handling.
  • You use modern AI coding tools as a core part of your engineering workflow and can effectively review and quality-control AI-generated code.
  • Evidence of making fast, high-quality decisions under ambiguity, including deciding what not to build.
  • Experience in healthcare, clinical workflows, FHIR, regulated or safety-critical software, or enterprise software deployments is a strong advantage, but not required.
  • Excellent written and spoken English. German is a plus, but not required.

Benefits

What we offer

  • End-to-end ownership of engineering, technology and delivery.
  • A product used in everyday oncology care, with the opportunity to shape its next stage of growth.
  • A small, senior and highly collaborative team of physicians, AI researchers and engineers.
  • Competitive compensation, including virtual stock options depending on experience and scope.
  • A pragmatic, low-bureaucracy environment with high autonomy and fast decision-making.
  • A fast, thoughtful hiring process that respects your time.

We welcome international candidates and run our hiring process in English.

Apply

Tell us about one product you helped take from ambiguity to production: what you owned, what you decided not to build and what changed for users. If you’ve built something you’re particularly proud of, we’d love to see it.

title: Werkstudent:in Marketing & Kommunikation (m/w/d) - Standort Berlin (hybrid)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Eventfrog
description_html:
Wir arbeiten standortübergreifend und nach den Prinzipien der Holacracy: ohne starre Hierarchien, dafür mit viel Eigenverantwortung, Autonomie und Raum für eigene Ideen. Als Werkstudent:in arbeitest du aktiv an unseren Marketingprojekten mit und gestaltest mit uns, wie Eventfrog weiterwächst. Eventfrog ist eine Event- und Ticketing-Plattform mit dem Ziel, die Eventbranche zu revolutionieren. Wir wollen Veranstalter:innen – vom kleinen Verein bis zum Großevent – erfolgreicher machen, zu einer vielfältigen und lebendigen Kulturlandschaft in Europa beitragen und einen Gegenpol zum Gigantismus der Eventindustrie schaffen.
Dafür bietet Eventfrog ein professionelles, gebührenfreies Online-Ticketing sowie zahlreiche Funktionen für die Organisation, Vermarktung und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen – von mehr Reichweite über den Ticketverkauf und Einlass bis zum bargeldlosen Bezahlen. In der Schweiz betreibt Eventfrog den größten Veranstaltungskalender und expandiert mit seiner Event- und Ticketing-Plattform in weitere europäische Märkte.

Aufgaben

Wie deine Arbeit aussehen wird

  • Du erstellst Content für unsere Website und Social-Media-Kanäle – von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Marketingprojekten und übernimmst dabei auch eigene Aufgaben und kleinere Projekte.
  • Du betreust unsere Social-Media-Community, interagierst mit unseren Nutzer:innen und beantwortest Fragen.
  • Du beobachtest Trends und Entwicklungen auf Social Media und bringst eigene Ideen für neue Inhalte und Formate ein.
  • Du unterstützt das Marketingteam dort, wo gerade etwas bewegt werden soll – und bekommst dabei Einblick in unterschiedliche Bereiche unseres Marketings.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in und kannst uns 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen.
  • Du hast Lust auf Marketing, Kommunikation und Social Media und möchtest praktische Erfahrung sammeln.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbständig und zuverlässig und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Content, Sprache und unterschiedliche Zielgruppen.
  • Du kennst die gängigen Social-Media-Plattformen und hast Freude daran, neue Trends und Formate auszuprobieren.
  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team, bringst eigene Ideen ein und bist offen dafür, Neues zu lernen.
  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau.

Benefits

Worauf du dich freuen kannst

  • Flexibles und autonomes Arbeiten (Homeoffice unkompliziert und flexibel möglich)
  • New Work & Holacracy
  • Ein kompetentes, interdisziplinäres Team mit offenem Arbeitsklima
  • Eine moderne Unternehmenskultur mit zeitgemässem Arbeitsplatz
  • Gratiseintritt für gesponserte Events
  • Unser Büro in Berlin-Wedding ist gut mit dem öffentlichen Verkehr erreichbar
  • Arbeitskolleg:innen, mit denen man nicht aneckt, sondern anstösst!
  • Bei gemeinsamen Firmenevents lernst du auch deine Kolleg:innen aus der Schweiz persönlich kennen

Schick uns deine Bewerbung

Du hast Lust, Teil unseres Teams zu werden? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Erzähl uns in deinem Anschreiben gerne kurz, warum du zu Eventfrog und in unser Team möchtest.

Zeig uns, was du kannst: Schick uns mit deiner Bewerbung gerne etwas mit, das deine Handschrift trägt – zum Beispiel ein Social-Media-Video, einen Post, einen Text oder ein anderes Content-Stück, auf das du stolz bist. Ob aus einem früheren Job, dem Studium oder einem eigenen Projekt, ist dabei ganz egal.

So geht es nach deiner Bewerbung weiter:
In einem ersten (Online-)Gespräch lernen wir uns gegenseitig kennen. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, folgt ein halbtägiger Kennenlerntag, der hybrid in unserem Berliner Büro und online stattfindet. Dabei lernst du verschiedene Kolleg:innen kennen und bekommst einen Einblick in die Zusammenarbeit bei Eventfrog und deinen zukünftigen Arbeitsalltag. Anschließend treffen wir zeitnah eine Entscheidung.

Nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllt? Bewirb dich trotzdem! 🐸

description_html:
Wir entwickeln und fertigen Radsätze und deren Komponenten mit der höchsten Qualität und für alle Arten von Schienenfahrzeugen: klassische Züge und Hochgeschwindigkeitszüge, U-Bahnen, Straßenbahnen und Nahverkehrswagen, Lokomotiven und Güterwagen. Und liefern in weltweit mehr als 80 Länder.

Wir sind Teil der Verkehrswende!

Wir suchen Unterstützung für unsere Abteilung „Engineering Light Rail“ .

Aufgaben

  • Eigenständige Durchführung von Bauteilprüfungen an GHH-Produkten (gummigefederte Räder, Vollräder, Komponenten, Elastomer-Bauteile) entsprechend der jeweiligen Anforderung
  • Montage, Demontage von GHH-Produkten
  • Unterstützung bei der technischen Untersuchung und Befundung von Rädern und deren Komponenten nach Betriebseinsätzen, Prüfstandversuchen oder vorzeitigen Ausfällen
  • Interne/externe Verfolgung von Projekten und technische Kommunikation mit externen Partnern
  • Erarbeitung von Prüfspezifikationen/Dokumentationen/Prüfberichten
  • Erstellung konstruktiver Entwürfe in CAD (SolidWorks): Vorrichtungen für Bauteilprüfungen und/oder konstruktive Modifikationen an bestehenden Bauteilen (z.B. Radreifen, Radkörpern oder Klemmringen) damit erforderliche Bauteilprüfungen ermöglicht werden
  • Abstimmung der Beschaffung der konstruktiven Entwürfe intern/extern

Vorbereitung von Prüfaufgaben, wie Kleben von Dehnmessstreifen oder Verkabelung verschiedener Sensoren

  • Erstellung von Prüfprogrammen in der entsprechenden Prüf-Software
  • Programmierung von Skripten zur Auswertung der Messdaten in Matlab, Famos oder Python

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Maschinenbau-Studium mit Abschluss als Diplom-Ingenieur bzw. Master Engineering, vorzugsweise mit der Vertiefungsrichtung
    (Schienen-)Fahrzeug- oder Konstruktionstechnik
  • Kenntnisse aus dem Bereich der statischen und dynamischen Bauteilprüfung
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Elektrik, Elektronik oder Mechatronik sowie Interesse an Mess- und Sensortechnik
  • Programmierkenntnisse in den genannten Programmen
  • Willen, sich immer wieder in neue Themengebiete einzuarbeiten und die gewonnenen Kenntnisse anzuwenden
  • kommunikative Fähigkeiten und sicheres Auftreten
  • Kreative, offene und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Bereitschaft, neue Wege zu gehen und fachübergreifende Ansätze einzubeziehen
  • Hohe Teamfähigkeit sowie Einsatzbereitschaft
  • sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen Office-Programmen und einem ERP-System
  • sehr gute Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache in Wort und Schrift
  • Bereitschaft zur flexiblen Arbeitszeitgestaltung
  • Körperliche Eignung für belastende körperliche Tätigkeiten und Arbeiten in verschiedenen Körperhaltungen
  • Bereitschaft zu Reisen, auch ins (außereuropäische) Ausland

Benefits

  • Gute Perspektiven und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einer wachsenden Branche
  • Möglichkeit zur persönlichen Entfaltung in einem traditionsreichen Umfeld
  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem Mittelstandsunternehmen mit sehr gutem Betriebsklima
  • Kurze Wege, offenes Miteinander und flache Hierarchien
  • Intensive Einarbeitung, breites Angebot an Fort- und Weiterbildungen sowie Raum
    zur persönlichen Entwicklung
  • Zentrale Lage in Oberhausen-Sterkrade (5 Gehminuten vom Bahnhof entfernt),
    gute Anbindung an das Autobahnnetz
  • Kostenlose Mitarbeiterparkplätze
  • Attraktive und leistungsgerechte Vergütung
  • Möglichkeit des Bike-Leasing und der betrieblichen Altersversorgung
  • Betriebliche Zusatzkrankenversicherung

unser Rad dreht sich stetig weiter!

beziehen sich die Angaben auf Angehörige aller Geschlechter.)

Qualifikation

title: Produkt- und Entwicklungsingenieur
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Gutehoffnungshütte Radsatz GmbH
description_html:
Wir entwickeln und fertigen Radsätze und deren Komponenten mit der höchsten Qualität und für alle Arten von Schienenfahrzeugen: klassische Züge und Hochgeschwindigkeitszüge, U-Bahnen, Straßenbahnen und Nahverkehrswagen, Lokomotiven und Güterwagen. Und liefern in weltweit mehr als 80 Länder.

Wir sind Teil der Verkehrswende!

Wir suchen Unterstützung für unsere Abteilung „Engineering Light Rail“ .

Aufgaben

  • Selbständige, konstruktive Bearbeitung von Projekten in Zusammenarbeit
    mit Kunden, Lieferanten, Zulassungsbehörden und den betroffenen internen
    Fachabteilungen
  • Konzeption, Berechnung und Konstruktion von Rädern, Radsätzen und Fahrwerkskomponenten für Schienenfahrzeuge
  • Prüfung der von Projekt- bzw. Berechnungsingenieuren oder -sachbearbeitern
    erstellten technischen Unterlagen auf Richtigkeit und Vollständigkeit
  • Ggfs. eigenständige Erstellung und Pflege der Produktdokumentationen (z.B. Wartungs- und Betriebsanleitungen)
  • Prüfung und Kommentierung von Lastenheften
  • Erstellung bzw. Prüfung und Freigabe von Pflichtenheften
  • Durchführung von Design-Reviews
  • Koordinierung von Projekten und Mitarbeit in Projektteams
  • Führen technischer Gespräche und Verhandlungen mit Kunden und Lieferanten

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Maschinenbau-Studium mit Abschluss als Diplom-Ingenieur bzw. Master Engineering, vorzugsweise mit der Vertiefungsrichtung
    (Schienen-)Fahrzeug- oder Konstruktionstechnik
  • Ausgeprägte Fachkenntnisse auf den Gebieten Konstruktion, Strukturmechanik, Berechnung und Werkstofftechnik
  • Erste Berufserfahrung in Industrie oder Forschung im Bereich der Entwicklung
    und Konstruktion von Fahrwerkskomponenten von Schienenfahrzeugen ist von
    Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich. Wir bieten auch Studienabgängern eine Einstiegsmöglichkeit.
  • Mindestens ausbaufähige Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von EDV- und Engineering Software-Produkten (CAD, SolidWorks)
  • Sichere Anwendung der englischen Sprache in Wort und Schrift
  • Teamfähigkeit,Einsatzbereitschaft, Kreativität und Flexibilität

Benefits

  • Gute Perspektiven und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einer wachsenden Branche
  • Möglichkeit zur persönlichen Entfaltung in einem traditionsreichen Umfeld
  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem Mittelstandsunternehmen mit sehr gutem Betriebsklima
  • Kurze Wege, offenes Miteinander und flache Hierarchien
  • Intensive Einarbeitung, breites Angebot an Fort- und Weiterbildungen sowie Raum
    zur persönlichen Entwicklung
  • Zentrale Lage in Oberhausen-Sterkrade (5 Gehminuten vom Bahnhof entfernt),
    gute Anbindung an das Autobahnnetz
  • Kostenlose Mitarbeiterparkplätze
  • Attraktive und leistungsgerechte Vergütung
  • Möglichkeit des Bike-Leasing und der betrieblichen Altersversorgung
  • Betriebliche Zusatzkrankenversicherung

Wir bringen gemeinsam Bewegung in die Welt von morgen –

unser Rad dreht sich stetig weiter!

(Auch wenn wir zur besseren Lesbarkeit im obigen Text die männliche Form gewählt haben,
beziehen sich die Angaben auf Angehörige aller Geschlechter.)

title: (Senior) Product Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Consultport
description_html:
Consultport is the leading digital platform that connects some of the world's most iconic brands with world-class consultants. We're scaling hard, and we need a PM obsessed with product-led growth (PLG).

Tasks

This role is not about babysitting a roadmap but turning the product itself into our best sales channel — removing friction, driving activation, and making users fall in love before they ever talk to sales.

What you'll do

- Own the PLG strategy: activation, onboarding, habit loops, and expansion

- Turn data into decisions: define metrics, run experiments, kill what doesn't work

- Work directly with Engineering, Design, and Data in a fast-moving Agile setup

- Identify and remove every drop of friction in the consultant and client journey

- Collaborate with Sales and Management to align product motions with revenue

Requirements

- 3+ years of PM experience, ideally at a marketplace or SaaS company

- You know what PLG actually means and have shipped it

- You use AI tools daily. If you don't, don't apply

- Sharp analytical skills: you live in dashboards and trust numbers over opinions

- Strong English, both written and spoken (C1 minimum)

- Based in or willing to relocate to Berlin for an onsite role

Benefits

- Direct impact on a two-sided marketplace used by thousands worldwide

- A sharp, driven team that moves fast and ships faster

- Work from our newly renovated Berlin office

- Real ownership from day one

- Company partnership with Urban Sports Club

- Contributions to your monthly public transportation ticket

- Unlimited snacks and drinks at the office

- Competitive compensation package

If product-led growth is what you eat for breakfast, not just a buzzword on your CV, your boarding call is now.

title: CEO / Business Co-Founder (f/m/d) role at startup FAMILY FLOW
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at SouthwestX
description_html:
FAMILY FLOW
Saarbrücken / Homburg, Saarland, Germany | Remote | Fulltime | Digital Health (DiGA)

About Family Flow
Family Flow is a scientifically grounded, trauma-sensitive parenting app that helps parents with their own history of adverse childhood experiences (ACEs) manage the moment between a trigger and their reaction to their child — building a personalized 'Flow Plan' (trigger → warning signs → pause → skill → parenting strategy) instead of another generic parenting app.

The opportunity
The concept is built on more than 20 years of clinical and scientific work on child maltreatment led by Prof. Dr. med. Eva Möhler, Chair of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry at Saarland University, alongside DFKI researchers Patrick Gebhard and Jan Alexandersson. The idea and clinical content are finalized — what's missing is the team and funding to build and launch the app. We are looking for a CEO / Business co-founder (fundraising, tech and operations) to turn a validated clinical concept into a real product.

Tasks

What you will own

Company build-up & fundraising
- Lead incorporation of Family Flow and raise the funding needed for app development (German, French and English versions).
- Own the path to the German DiGA directory (digital health app reimbursement) and the parallel free-market / B2C launch.

Product & delivery
- Translate the finalized clinical concept and psychotherapeutic material into a software roadmap, in partnership with a tech/development team or subcontractor (e.g. potential partnerships with Pioneo, Pfeffermind or Charamel).
- Own day-to-day operations, as the current interdisciplinary team (DFKI + Child and Adolescent Psychiatry) is part-time only.

Go-to-market
- Build the launch plan for Germany and France, then wider Europe, including social-media-led B2C acquisition alongside the DiGA pathway.

Requirements

What you bring

Core experience
- Fundraising experience (grants and/or investors) and comfort building a company from an academic/clinical concept.
- Hands-on operations and project management skills; willingness to work full-time (the current founding team is part-time).

Especially valuable
- Experience with the digital health / DiGA regulatory pathway in Germany.
- Software/product background, or strong ability to manage external development partners.
- Interest in child psychiatry, trauma-informed care or parenting technology.

Benefits

Why join Family Flow
- A clinically validated concept backed by 20+ years of research and a published evidence base, not an unproven idea.
- Direct partnership with a University Professor and Chair of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry at Saarland University.
- Address a problem estimated to cost society €20 billion in Germany alone (Deutsche Traumafolgekostenstudie), with a clear DiGA reimbursement path.

Family Flow welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. This is a search for the right partner to build the company with, not a conventional hire.
