title: Art Director (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Panama Werbeagentur GmbH
description_html:
Auch wenn Wikipedia etwas anderes behauptet: Panama liegt nicht in Mittelamerika, sondern in Stuttgart – und ist eine inhabergeführte Kreativagentur mit tollen Kunden und spannenden Projekten quer durch alle Medien.

Du brauchst also kein Visum, um bei uns einzusteigen – nur deine außergewöhnlichen Fähigkeiten und viel Leidenschaft für herausragende Kommunikation. Und dabei macht jede*r Einzelne den Unterschied.

Aufgaben

  • Eigenständige Konzeption von vielseitigen Kommunikationsmaßnahmen (Offline & Online)
  • Entwicklung von außergewöhnlichen Ideen
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten innerhalb eines Teams
  • Unterstützung bei der Betreuung von Film- und Foto-Produktionen

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Kreativagentur, auf nationalen wie internationalen Marken und digitalem Background
  • Shooting-Erfahrung (Film & Foto)
  • Sicheres Gespür für Typografie und gute Gestaltung
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Souveräner Umgang mit den Programmen der Creative Suite
  • Ein Kopf, der voller kreativer Ideen steckt

Benefits

  • Eine tragende Rolle in einer stetig wachsenden Agentur
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit einem starken Team an deiner Seite
  • Flache Hierarchien und eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre
  • Vielseitiges Kundenspektrum mit großen Marken und international eingesetzten Kampagnen
  • Unterstützung in deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung, sowie agentureigene Weiterbildungsveranstaltungen (Panama-Academy)
  • Leistungsgerechte Vergütung und einen Zuschuss für deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle mit mobilem Arbeiten an zwei Tagen pro Woche und der Möglichkeit für Workation
  • 30 Urlaubstage und ein umfassendes Gesundheitsmanagement mit Sportkurs, Betriebsarzt und Vorsorgeangeboten
  • Täglich frisches Obst, Mineralwasser, Kaffee und Tee. Und nach Feierabend auch kühles Bierchen oder ein Glas Sekt.
  • Zentrale Lage mit unmittelbarer Nähe zu den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln und für alle Sport-Fans: Bikeleasing
  • Legendäre Mitarbeiter*innenevents und verschiedene Panama Atletico Sportangebote – Fußball, Laufen, Skiausfahrten und noch vieles mehr

Interessiert? Zeig uns, was Du kannst, und sende uns deine vollständige Bewerbung. Vergiss bitte nicht, uns deinen nächstmöglichen Eintrittstermin sowie deine Gehaltsvorstellung mitzuteilen. Wir freuen uns dich kennenzulernen!

Eugensplatz 1 | 70184 Stuttgart

title: Key Account Executive
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Sine Engineering
description_html:
About Sine Engineering

Sine Engineering builds the technology behind reliable drone autonomy, delivering communication, navigation, and control systems that enable coordinated multi-drone operations. More than 200 UAV manufacturers rely on our solutions, and our technology powers many of the interceptor operations active today.

Through our dual-use platform, we support civilian innovation while helping democratic nations strengthen their technological advantage.

Any drone. Any scale. Anywhere. Resilient communication, navigation, and coordination built for the age of autonomy. Our products have already proven their effectiveness in real combat conditions in Ukraine.

Responsibilities

  • Build and expand Sine Engineering's customer and partner network across Germany.

  • Identify, engage, and develop strategic accounts across the defense, aerospace, UAV manufacturing, systems integration, robotics, electronics, telecommunications, RF, autonomy, and other related technology sectors.

  • Own the full sales cycle, including market mapping, prospecting, qualification, discovery, technical evaluation, proposal development, negotiation, closing, and long-term account growth.

  • Develop relationships with OEMs, system integrators, defense primes, technology partners, and relevant government-affiliated stakeholders.

  • Build direct relationships with senior executives and C-level decision-makers while developing strong engagement across engineering, program management, and procurement functions.

  • Position Sine Engineering effectively before formal procurement and tender processes begin.

  • Lead customer discussions related to communication modules, GNSS-denied navigation systems, video links, embedded autonomy software, and integration opportunities.

  • Coordinate technical evaluations, pilot projects, demonstrations, and integration discussions in collaboration with product and engineering teams.

  • Prepare commercial proposals, pricing structures, contract documentation, and partnership models.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, including pricing, volume commitments, long-term agreements, and commercial frameworks.

  • Maintain high standards of CRM management, pipeline tracking, revenue forecasting, and account planning in line with European business operations.

  • Provide market intelligence regarding German defense procurement, competitors, customer requirements, funding priorities, and partnership opportunities.

  • Represent Sine Engineering at industry events, trade shows, conferences, and customer meetings across Germany and Europe.

  • Help establish scalable and repeatable sales processes for the German market and contribute to future team growth.

  • Work closely with the Managing Director Germany to ensure commercial account ownership and local market representation remain aligned and complementary.


    Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, strategic account management, or partnerships within a complex technical environment.

  • Proven track record of managing full-cycle sales processes with enterprise, industrial, defense, aerospace, or technology customers.

  • Strong understanding of long sales cycles, multi-stakeholder procurement processes, and complex commercial negotiations.

  • Ability to understand technical products and translate customer needs into clear business and technical requirements.

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineering, product, operations, legal, and executive leadership teams.

  • Excellent commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and executive-level communication abilities.

  • Ability to work independently, proactively creating opportunities rather than relying primarily on inbound leads.

  • Strong sense of ownership and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, scale-up environment.

  • Ability to work effectively in a matrix organization, collaborating with both a functional sales manager and a local managing director.

  • Based in Munich or willing to travel there regularly.

  • Willingness to travel frequently across Germany, Ukraine, and Europe.

    Nice to Have

  • Experience in the defense, aerospace, UAV, robotics, telecommunications, RF, or deep-tech sectors.

  • Experience building a market presence, territory, or sales function from an early stage.

  • Experience working with international teams, particularly across Germany and Eastern Europe.

  • Experience negotiating framework agreements and other long-term commercial partnerships.


Why Join Us?

If you're excited about building technology that shapes the future of drone autonomy and want your work to have a meaningful impact on defense and security, we'd love to hear from you.

If this role aligns with your experience and ambitions, don't hesitate to apply. We're looking for people who share our drive to push the boundaries of what's possible and deliver technologies that make a real-world difference.

description_html:

ClickHouse — Core Analytics Database

About the Role:
ClickHouse is looking for a Principal Database Performance Engineer to join the team behind our high-performance analytics database service.
In this role, you will drive performance and scalability improvements across the stack, taking on ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges most engineers never get to touch.
Our performance team owns the core of query execution - filters, aggregation, joins, and the index structures that make them fast.
We're looking for a sharp, passionate engineer who wants to own database performance end-to-end on a petabyte-scale cloud database, from initial analysis and implementation, through production rollout.

What you will do:
- Identify impactful performance and scalability opportunities in customer or benchmark workloads
- Architect and implement optimized database algorithms and data structures across core relational operators, indexes, query processing, memory management and scheduling
- Drive the performance roadmap for latency, throughput, memory efficiency and hardware utilization improvements
- Participate in the development of a complex, high-performance database system, including meticulous testing and safe production rollout
- Represent the company externally through presentations, blog posts, and community contributions
- Mentor and support junior engineers on the team

What You'll Bring
- 5+ years of experience in database performance engineering, distributed systems
- Master or PhD in databases or a related field
- Strong fluency in C++ and a background in performance-critical software or systems programming
- A track record of driving complex performance improvements end-to-end
- Deep understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms
- Excellent communication and leadership skills, with a proactive, goal-driven mindset

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

About the Role

This is a founding senior attorney opportunity at an AI-native law firm in Germany, building the firm's client base and market presence from the ground up. You will bring an established portable book of business onto a proprietary agentic legal platform, acting as both a client-facing rainmaker and a key voice in shaping the firm's commercial growth. What You'll Do

  • Open top-of-funnel opportunities through your private equity, venture capital, and mid-market network.

  • Cross-sell commercial and compliance legal services into your existing client base.

  • Collaborate with the founding team to move recurring matters onto the AI automation platform.

What We're Looking For

  • 12 or more years of experience as a partner-level attorney at a top-ranked German law firm, with a focus on PE/VC and corporate sectors.

  • German-qualified Volljurist with active Rechtsanwalt bar admission.

  • A portable, personally held client book of €1M or more, weighted toward PE/VC clients and their portfolio companies.

Compensation & Benefits

Base compensation of €200,000 to €300,000 annually, plus meaningful equity in a technology-driven legal venture. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Germany-based, with Berlin in-person work preferred. Hybrid arrangement with flexibility for remote work.

title: Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Tactiliarobotics
description_html:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

You design the mechanics of our robotic hands — from the kinematics of a single finger to a complete hand ready for series production.

Multiple drives, gear trains, tendons, tactile sensors and electronics have to fit into a human-sized envelope while surviving hundreds of thousands of cycles. Every millimetre matters, and almost every design decision affects another discipline.

You work hands-on between CAD, test rig and workshop, and report to the CTO.

What you will do:

  • CAD design. Design components, mechanisms and assemblies within tightly constrained envelopes, owning the design from concept through production release.

  • Mechanism & kinematics. Design finger and thumb kinematics, tendon and spindle drives, joints and bearings. Calculate motion envelopes, trajectories, gripping forces and transmission ratios.

  • Calculation & validation. Validate designs through structural and fatigue calculations, FEA, tolerance stack-ups and GD&T before parts are manufactured.

  • Material selection. Select and qualify materials for lightweight structures, wear surfaces, tendons and elastomeric gripping surfaces, and characterise their behaviour under real loads and contact conditions.

  • Assembly design. Design assemblies for efficient assembly, adjustment-free interfaces, serviceability and repair. Specify the required fixtures and tooling.

  • Design for manufacturing. Design for the intended manufacturing process from the outset — machining, injection moulding, sheet metal, additive manufacturing — balancing cost, tolerances and production volumes.

  • Prototyping & testing. Build prototypes, design test rigs and endurance setups, run cycle and load tests, and drive failures to root cause.

  • Documentation & release. Create drawings and BOMs, manage design changes and configuration, and support product development reviews.

  • Suppliers & production. Work with machine shops, material suppliers and manufacturing partners from first prototype through pilot series and production ramp-up.

  • Cross-functional integration. Work closely with Electronics, Sensors and Software to align packaging, interfaces and load paths across the complete system.

What you bring:

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, precision engineering, or a comparable qualification.

  • 5–10 years of experience in mechanical design of precision mechatronic products, including at least one product taken through to series production.

  • Advanced 3D CAD skills in CATIA, NX, SolidWorks, Creo or comparable systems, with confident 2D drawing creation and GD&T.

  • Strong understanding of mechanism design: linkages, gear trains, bearings, shafts, power transmission, backlash and stiffness.

  • Experience with FEA, structural and fatigue analysis, and tolerance calculations as part of everyday design work.

  • Strong knowledge of material selection for lightweight, high-load and wear-critical components.

  • Practical DFM/DFA experience across multiple manufacturing processes.

  • Hands-on mentality — you build the prototype, run the test and analyse the broken part yourself.

  • Fluent in English and German.

Bonus:

  • Experience with robotic hands, grippers, prosthetics or similarly highly integrated mechanisms.

  • Experience with compact drive trains, including planetary, harmonic or cycloidal gearing, spindle drives and actuator integration.

  • Experience with elastomers, soft goods, injection moulding of complex geometries or compliant structures.

  • Experience integrating tactile or force sensors into mechanical structures.

  • Experience with multi-body simulation or topology optimisation.

  • Knowledge of Machinery Regulation, ISO/TS 15066 and mechanical design for collaborative applications.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

You will join at the moment when the hard robotics questions become real product decisions: how do we turn customer needs into a highly capable robotic hand that is reliable, manufacturable, and ready to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As a Chief Technology Officer, you will own TACTILIA's technology strategy, product architecture, and engineering execution. You will lead a multidisciplinary organization across project management, systems engineering, mechanics, electronics, sensorics, embedded and robotics software, AI, product management, applications and testing. Your responsibility is to turn a highly capable robotic hand into a reliable, manufacturable, serviceable and scalable industrial product.

This is a leadership role with substantial technical depth. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in every discipline, but you must have first-hand experience with both hardware and software development and the judgment to make sound system-level decisions across both.

What you will do:

Set the technology direction. Define TACTILIA’s technology strategy and product roadmap from the current platform to a scalable industrial product.

Lead the whole stack. Lead the teams across project management, systems, mechanics, electronics, sensorics, embedded and robotics software, AI, product, applications and testing.

Make the architecture work. Own the system architecture and the interfaces between hardware, software, AI and applications.

Turn R&D into product. Drive the transition from advanced prototypes to reliable, manufacturable, serviceable and customer-ready products.

Make the right trade-offs. Balance performance, reliability, cost, safety, manufacturability and speed of execution.

Build the organization. Recruit, develop and lead the engineering and product organization across Zurich and Munich.

Create clarity and accountability. Establish effective priorities, processes, decision-making structures and technical standards across the teams.

Own resources and execution. Manage engineering budgets, headcount and priorities in line with the company’s product and business goals.

Stay close to customers. Translate customer requirements and field experience into product decisions and future technology direction.

Represent TACTILIA externally. Act as the technical face of the company with customers, partners, SCHUNK, investors and the robotics community.

Stay close to the hard problems. Remain sufficiently hands-on to challenge important technical decisions and unblock the team when necessary.

What you bring:

You can lead across hardware and software. You have deep practical understanding of both disciplines and the credibility to guide experts across mechanics, electronics, sensors, embedded systems, controls, AI and applications.

You have led complex engineering organizations. You have successfully led multidisciplinary teams, ideally with responsibility for 20 or more people, multiple functions and a significant budget.

You have shipped physical products. You have taken complex robotics, mechatronics, medical or industrial hardware from development or prototype stage into customer use, production or product maturity.

You understand human-like robotic systems. Ideally, you have experience in humanoid or biomedical robotics, particularly with anthropomorphic mechanisms, sensor and actuator systems, robotic hands or tendon-driven devices.

You think in systems. You can connect mechanics, electronics, sensing, control, software, AI and customer applications into a coherent product architecture.

You build teams that execute. You have a track record of recruiting strong people, developing leaders and creating a culture of ownership and high standards.

You know how to scale engineering. You bring experience from a startup, scale-up or industrial technology company and understand how to combine speed with disciplined execution.

You make sound decisions under uncertainty. You are pragmatic, commercially aware and able to distinguish between the perfect solution and the right solution.

You communicate with every audience. You can engage credibly with engineers, customers, executives, investors and industrial partners.

You have a strong technical foundation. A degree in engineering, computer science, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred.

You are ready to build internationally. You are fluent in English and comfortable working across the Zurich and Munich locations. German is an advantage.

Bonus:

  • Dexterous manipulation, grasp planning, or robotic hands

  • Tactile sensing and contact-rich manipulation

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Staff Product Manager: Agentic Discovery
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Constructor
description_html:
Staff Product Manager, Agentic Discovery

About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary We're looking for a systems-minded, AI-native Staff Product Manager to help lead the next chapter of Constructor: Agentic Discovery. As commerce shifts toward agentic experiences, we're investing heavily in a portfolio of AI-powered surfaces — our AI Shopping Assistant, Product Insights Agent, Prism recommendations, and more to come — that change how shoppers discover products and how businesses run discovery.

This is a high-leverage, high-ambiguity role. You'll own two things at once: helping our agentic experiences scale from promising experiments into a repeatable, reliable engine, and giving the business teams who depend on them the same transparency and control over agentic experiences that they have today over traditional search.

You'll start by owning the business tooling and dashboards for agentic discovery — the experiences that let business teams see what our agents are doing, why, and to what effect, so they can execute faster and steer with confidence. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Agentic Discovery chapter: the on-site agentic experiences, the offsite/agentic surfaces, the integrations that connect them, and the agentic tooling underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Agentic discovery at Constructor is fundamentally an AI and machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes it. You'll partner closely with ML, engineering, design, and go-to-market to turn new agentic capabilities into experiences that ship, prove value, and stay under our customers' control — and serve as the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams behind one coherent vision for agentic discovery.

If you're excited about defining a brand-new category, being held to real usage and business outcomes, and giving businesses control over the AI experiences shaping their storefronts, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in usage and business outcomes — conversion, revenue, engagement — across Constructor's agentic experiences.

  • Give businesses transparency and control. Build the dashboards and tooling that let business teams see what agentic experiences are doing, understand why, and steer them — closing the gap to the control they have in traditional search.

  • Scale experimentation. Turn one-off agentic experiments into a repeatable, scalable way to launch, measure, and improve new agentic interfaces — cutting time-to-launch.

  • Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for Agentic Discovery — where we're heading and why — tie it to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

  • Lead the business-tooling and dashboard experience first. Own its strategy and roadmap, and make agentic behavior and impact visible and actionable for business users.

     

  • Orchestrate across surfaces. Unite on-site agentic experiences, offsite/agentic surfaces, and integrations behind one definition of agentic discovery success, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

     

  • Turn AI capability into shipped experiences. Partner with ML and engineering to take agentic and LLM-powered experiences from idea to production, balancing quality, latency, cost, and reliability.

     

  • Make success measurable. Define and instrument the metrics — go-live velocity, usage, engagement, business outcomes — that tell us whether agentic discovery is working.

     

  • Keep it trustworthy. Treat explainability, control, and guardrails as first-class requirements so customers trust and adopt agentic experiences.

     

  • Grow the mandate. Expand from business tooling into chapter-wide leadership across the full agentic portfolio and the integrations beneath it.

What Success Looks Like Within your first year, you will have:

  • Shipped a dashboard and tooling experience that gives business teams real transparency into and control over Constructor's agentic experiences, adopted by internal teams and customers.

  • Driven measurable lift in the usage and business impact (conversion, revenue) of agentic experiences across multiple customers.

  • Stood up a repeatable process for launching and experimenting with new agentic interfaces, measurably shortening time-to-launch.

  • Defined the core metrics for agentic discovery and made them visible in one place.

  • Begun uniting the on-site, offsite, and integrations teams behind one coherent direction for the chapter.

What We're Looking For

  • Extensive product management experience (typically 8+ years) in AI/ML, agentic, search, or discovery products, including time operating at a senior or staff level.

  • A track record of moving business metrics at scale — usage, conversion, revenue, engagement — not just shipping features, and of setting strategy across multiple teams.

  • Experience building for business users/operators (merchandisers, category managers, or similar) — especially the tooling, dashboards, and controls they rely on.

  • Strong AI/ML/LLM product depth — understands how agentic and LLM-powered experiences work and can reason about their tradeoffs (quality, latency, cost, reliability).

  • Comfort with zero-to-one ambiguity and with scaling — able to experiment on brand-new interfaces and to build the repeatable process that turns them into a portfolio.

  • A rigorous, measurement-first mindset that ties every experience back to usage and business outcomes.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership — able to align teams with different goals behind a shared definition of success, working shoulder-to-shoulder with ML, engineering, design, and go-to-market.

  • A strong instinct for trust — treating transparency, control, and guardrails as core to whether agentic experiences succeed.

  • Comfort setting direction where none exists yet, and leading through clarity and credibility rather than the org chart.

Benefits

  • Unlimited vacation time — we strongly encourage all of our employees to take at least 3 weeks per year.

  • A competitive compensation package including stock options.

  • Company-sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee).

  • Fully remote team — choose where you live.

  • Work-from-home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office.

  • Apple laptops provided for new employees.

  • Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year.

  • Parental leave for qualified employees.

  • Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact.

This position is fully remote — Constructor.io is a remote-first company.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor At Constructor.io, we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or affiliation in any other protected group.

How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description_html:
Overview of the role

We’re on a mission to modernize insurance, making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that’s remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here to change that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re building the future of insurance in Canada and beyond.

We're building a groundbreaking new product line that will transform the insurance broker experience through AI and machine learning. As an AI-Driven Full Stack Engineer, you'll be part of a team charting new territory - designing and implementing intelligent systems that automate manual processes and unlock powerful data-driven insights.

You will work across the stack, contributing to front end, back end, and AI/ML initiatives, while also participating in architecture discussions, release planning, and company-wide engineering initiatives. Our core stack includes Python, React, Redux, PostgreSQL, n8n, LangChain/LangGraph and AWS, and we are always open to adopting new tools and technologies that help us deliver better results

What you'll be doing:

  • Leading the design and development of full stack features for our AI-powered web application using Python, React, Redux, PostgreSQL, and AWS
  • Defining the technical vision and architectural principles for AI/ML systems
  • Driving innovation by researching and prototyping cutting-edge AI technologies
  • Ensuring security, scalability, and observability best practices across cloud architecture
  • Work within a cross-functional environment partnering closely with product, design, and business teams to communicate technical designs/strategies
  • Serve as a role model for engineering standards and bring consistency across systems and processes while mentoring junior and intermediate engineers
  • Help drive sound technical decision-making across ambiguous, system-spanning problems

What we are looking for:

  • A strong technical background with 5+ years of experience in fullstack web development and production AI/ML systems
  • Deep expertise in AI/ML domains like NLP, computer vision, recommendation engines etc.
  • Proficiency with cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, microservices
  • Proven ability to architect and lead end-to-end AI projects, including security best practices
  • Exceptional technical communication and knowledge sharing abilities
  • Track record of managing ambiguity and delivering innovative solutions
  • An appreciation for fast-paced startup environments and experience building foundational systems
  • Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous technical challenges and drive them to resolution with cross-functional teams
  • Strong development skills in React, Python, and Node, or equivalent technologies with the ability to ramp up quickly

Why join us:

  • Generous PTO - 20 vacation days
  • A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe
  • Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential
  • An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry
  • Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!)
  • Access to stock options based on performance
  • Compensation: The total target cash compensation for this role is $154,000 - $176,000 CAD, based on experience. We’ll walk through the details together during the interview.

Compensation

Additional Information

About PolicyMe

At PolicyMe, we are Canada’s leading digital insurance solution, offering straightforward and affordable financial protection for families from coast to coast. Our product suite includes Life Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Health & Dental Insurance, all tailored to Canadians' evolving needs. We also offer B2B2C solutions, partnering with organizations to provide seamless digital insurance options. Founded by a team of insurance experts and technology entrepreneurs, PolicyMe is committed to making insurance simpler and more accessible. Since our launch in 2018, we have grown exponentially, selling over $10 billion in insurance coverage to Canadians.

We are proud of the team we’ve built and are excited for those that are yet to join us. We operate with a remote-first culture, attracting top talent from across Canada. If you’re looking for a fast-paced, collaborative environment, working alongside incredibly ambitious yet humble humans, we may be the right place for you! To learn more, visit www.policyme.com.

Additional Notes

- Job Vacancy: This role reflects growth in our team and expanded operational scope. We’re hiring to support increasing demand and continue delivering an exceptional customer experience.

- Commitment to Equal Opportunity: PolicyMe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and provide fair consideration regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

- Accessibility Statement: We are committed to providing an accessible hiring experience. If you require accommodations during the application process, please indicate this in the “Additional Information” section of your application.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Atlassian Administrator 1726
description_html:
This is a remote position.

We are seeking an experienced Atlassian Administrator to manage, optimize, and continuously improve our Atlassian Cloud ecosystem. This role will be responsible for the administration, configuration, customization, and support of Jira Software, Confluence, and Jira Service Management (JSM) , ensuring these platforms effectively support business processes and operational goals across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent problem-solving and communication skills, and has experience designing scalable solutions, automating workflows, integrating enterprise systems, and supporting end users in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain Atlassian Cloud products, including Jira Software, Confluence, and Jira Service Management.
  • Configure and manage Jira projects, issue types, custom fields, screens, workflows, permission schemes, and notification schemes.
  • Create and maintain Confluence spaces, templates, permissions, and knowledge-sharing structures.
  • Design, configure, and optimize Jira Service Management portals, request types, queues, and ITSM workflows.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business processes into scalable Atlassian solutions.
  • Develop and maintain advanced automations using Automation for Jira, ScriptRunner (Groovy), and Atlassian APIs.
  • Manage integrations with enterprise platforms such as Okta, Azure AD, DevOps tools, and other third-party systems.
  • Administer user access, groups, permissions, and Single Sign-On (SSO) configurations.
  • Conduct periodic access reviews and support compliance and audit requirements.
  • Monitor platform performance, troubleshoot issues, and resolve incidents related to Atlassian products and integrations.
  • Manage Atlassian Marketplace apps, ensuring compatibility, security, and performance.
  • Provide technical support and guidance to end users, resolving issues and answering platform-related questions.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and user guides.
  • Deliver training sessions and promote best practices for Jira, Confluence, and Jira Service Management usage.
  • Participate in governance initiatives, platform optimization, and continuous improvement efforts.

Requisitos

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience administering Atlassian platforms in enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience managing Jira Software, Confluence, and Jira Service Management Cloud .

Technical Skills

  • Strong expertise in:
    • Jira workflow design and administration.
    • Custom fields, screens, permission schemes, and notification schemes.
    • Confluence administration and space management.
    • Jira Service Management (JSM) and ITSM process implementation.
  • Experience developing automations using:
    • Automation for Jira.
    • ScriptRunner (Groovy).
    • Atlassian REST APIs.
  • Experience integrating Atlassian products with external systems using APIs, webhooks, and middleware solutions.
  • Knowledge of identity and access management solutions, including Okta , SSO, and SAML.
  • Experience managing users, groups, permissions, and security controls within cloud environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills related to Atlassian configurations, integrations, and platform performance.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript is highly desirable.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong customer-service mindset and user support experience.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team player with a proactive and solution-oriented approach.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Atlassian certifications (ACP or equivalent).
  • ITIL Foundation certification.
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, finance, or other compliance-driven environments.
  • Experience leading Atlassian implementations, migrations, or governance initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience with SQL, reporting tools, or Business Intelligence solutions.
  • Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as HIPAA, SOX, GDPR, or similar regulations.

Position Details

Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Level: Senior
Language Requirement: Advanced English (B2+/C1) required

title: IT Change Manager (w/m/d) - Software Rollout & Digitalisierung
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Arsipa GmbH
description_html:
Du möchtest digitale Veränderungen verständlich machen, Gesellschaften bei IT- und Software-Rollouts begleiten und dafür sorgen, dass neue Systeme im Arbeitsalltag wirklich ankommen? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:

IT Change Manager (w/m/d) - Software Rollout & Digitalisierung

Als IT Change Manager (w/m/d) - Software Rollout & Digitalisierung begleitest Du unsere Tochtergesellschaften bei der Einführung neuer IT-Standards, digitaler Lösungen und Softwareanwendungen - von Microsoft 365, Outlook, MFA und neuen Endgeräten bis hin zu unserer eigenen Softwareplattform GiniSuite. Dabei übersetzt Du technische Veränderungen in verständliche Kommunikation, praktische Hilfestellungen, Trainings und strukturierte Rollout-Maßnahmen für Führungskräfte, Key User und operative Teams. Dafür brauchen wir Deine Unterstützung!

Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, People, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Change-Kommunikation & Enablement

    • Zielgruppengerechte Kommunikation für anstehende IT- und Software-Rollouts entwickelst Du für unsere Tochtergesellschaften.

    • Technische Veränderungen übersetzt Du verständlich und vermittelst, was sich verändert und welche Unterstützung zur Verfügung steht.

    • Hilfestellungen, Trainingsmaterialien, FAQs und kurze Anleitungen erstellst Du für unterschiedliche Anwendergruppen.

    • Führungskräfte, Key User und operative Teams befähigst Du zur sicheren Nutzung neuer digitaler Lösungen.

  • Rollout-Vorbereitung & Umsetzung

    • Unsere Tochtergesellschaften bereitest Du strukturiert auf anstehende IT- und Software-Rollouts vor.

    • Organisatorische Vorbereitungsthemen wie Zugänge, Hardware, Daten, Field Mapping, Trainings und lokale Kommunikation koordinierst Du.

    • Go-lives und Hypercare-Phasen begleitest Du mit Blick auf Akzeptanz, Nutzung und offene Fragestellungen.

    • Feedback aus den Gesellschaften nimmst Du auf und stimmst notwendige Verbesserungen mit dem Group IT Team ab.

  • Schnittstellenmanagement & Standardisierung

    • Eng arbeitest Du mit Geschäftsführungen, Führungskräften, Key Usern und operativen Teams unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen.

    • Technische Anforderungen übersetzt Du in konkrete und umsetzbare Maßnahmen für den Arbeitsalltag.

    • Lokale Key-User- und Multiplikatoren-Netzwerke baust Du auf und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter.

    • Erfahrungen aus bisherigen Rollouts überführst Du in wiederverwendbare Standards, Methoden und Playbooks.

Deine Startvoraussetzungen:

  • Das bringst Du mit:

    • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Change Management, Rollout Management, Projektmanagement oder in der digitalen Transformation bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage.

    • Praxis in der Begleitung von IT-, Software- oder Tool-Einführungen bringst Du bereits mit.

    • Stärke in Kommunikation, Moderation und Stakeholder-Management ermöglicht Dir die sichere Begleitung unterschiedlicher Zielgruppen durch Veränderungsprozesse.

    • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie eine strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise runden Dein Profil ab.

  • Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein:

    • Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365, Outlook, MFA, digitalen Arbeitsplätzen oder geschäftskritischen Softwarelösungen wäre von Vorteil.

    • Ein Grundverständnis für IT-Infrastrukturen, Benutzer- und Berechtigungskonzepte oder Software- und Datenlandschaften ist wünschenswert.

    • Kenntnisse in Change-Management-Methoden wie ADKAR oder Kotter wären ein Plus.

    • Freude daran, unterschiedliche Gesellschaften, Führungskräfte und Teams für gemeinsame Lösungen zu gewinnen, hilft Dir, Veränderungen nachhaltig in der Organisation zu verankern.

description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Du bringst 15 - 20 Stunden pro Woche mit und unterstützt unser Team bei der Weiterentwicklung und Vermittlung von Fachwissen rund um erneuerbare Energien und digitale Schulungsinhalte.

Dabei übernimmst du unter anderem:

  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Schulungsunterlagen und Lerninhalten
  • Eigenständige Recherche und Aufbereitung von Themen aus dem Bereich erneuerbare Energien
  • Unterstützung bei der Konzeption und Durchführung von Schulungen

  • Ansprechpartner*in für Anwenderfragen rund um das Tool Elephant
  • Abstimmung und Kommunikation mit dem Elephant-Team
  • Analyse von Fehlern und Nutzerfeedback sowie Mitarbeit bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen und Inhalten
  • Unterstützung bei organisatorischen und administrativen Aufgaben im Schulungsumfeld


Deine Qualifikation

  • Laufendes Studium im Bereich Erneuerbare Energien, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis und Interesse an Energiethemen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word)
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Freude am Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern
  • Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Spaß daran, Wissen verständlich aufzubereiten und weiterzugeben
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau)
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2-Niveau)
Nice to have: 
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit KI-Anwendungen oder digitalen Lernplattformen
  • Erfahrungen mit Elephant oder vergleichbaren Schulungsplattformen
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Erstellung von Schulungen, Workshops oder Präsentationen


Deine Benefits

  • Der Teamspirit unter uns ist wirklich einzigartig: Dich empfängt ein familiäres Team, das Dich nach zwei Tagen vergessen lässt, dass Du neu bist
  • Wir sind Fans von kurzen Entscheidungswegen, pragmatischen Lösungen und ehrlicher Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe
  • Dich erwarten Benefits wie ein Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, eine kostenlose Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club und Mitarbeiterrabatte

  • Im Süden von Köln, direkt am Rhein, findest du deinen neuen Arbeitsplatz – bestens erreichbar durch die Bahnhaltestelle direkt vor der Tür. Die Dachterrasse mit Domblick bietet dir zudem den idealen Ort für Erholung und frische Ideen.
  • Wir wollen uns mit Dir weiterentwickeln: gemeinsam schmieden wir Pläne für Deine Karriere bei uns und setzen die Pläne in die Tat um
  • Durch unser nachhaltiges Geschäftsmodell in der Photovoltaikbranche bieten wir Dir eine sinnvolle Tätigkeit und die Möglichkeit, die Energiewende gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben

title: UI / UX Designer untermStrich (m/w/d) – Hamburg
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Everii Germany Gmbh 3
description_html:
Work @ everii

Du begeisterst dich für B2B SaaS Software? Dein TikTok- und Insta-Feed ist voller UI-Inspirationen? Du weißt, dass Software nicht nur funktional sein muss, sondern auch ein Ort zum Wohlfühlen sein sollte. Bist du stets am Puls der Zeit, was die neusten Trends im Bereich Software-Design angeht?

Dann solltest du jetzt weiterlesen!


Was dich erwartet

In unserem Angebot haben wir eine spannende, abwechslungsreiche Stelle als UI / UX Designer im everii Kosmos – mit der Möglichkeit, aktiv die Zukunft eines unserer Kern-Produkte mitzugestalten.

Als UI / UX Designer gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft von untermStrich, unserer ERP-SaaS-Lösung für Architektur- und Planungsbüros.
Auf Basis von Feature-Konzepten entwirfst du ansprechende UI/UX Designs in Figma – und bringst dabei stets dein eigenes Feedback aus UI/UX Perspektive ein, statt Konzepte nur „blind“ umzusetzen.

Du bist im engen Austausch mit unseren Kunden und Kundenteams, kennst ihre Anforderungen genau und entwickelst unsere Produkte kontinuierlich weiter.

Ein besonderes Highlight: Du begleitest und prägst das Re-Design von untermStrich und gestaltest den Look & Feel aktiv mit.
Das klingt nach dir? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Perfect Match!


Deine Aufgaben

  • UI / UX Designer: Du erstellst auf Basis der Konzepte unseres Produktmanagements Designs für untermStrich, unsere ERP-Lösung für Architektur- und Planungsbüros.
  • UX-Flows gestalten: Du denkst, kreierst und verbesserst UX-Flows und sorgst dafür, dass sich die Software für unsere Kunden intuitiv und stimmig anfühlt.
  • Designsprache weiterentwickeln: Du bringst unsere Designsprache auf das nächste Level.
  • Designumbau unseres Produkts: Aktuell arbeiten wir an einem größeren Designumbau. Du arbeitest hier im absoluten Herzen des Produkts.
  • Regelmäßiger Kundenkontakt: Du bist im ständigen Austausch mit unseren Kunden und Kundenteams, um ihre Anforderungen und Prozesse genau zu kennen.


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung im UI / UX Design: Du hast bereits im Design für Software-Produkte gearbeitet und kannst mit den gängigen Tools (wir nutzen z. B. Figma und Youtrack) umgehen.
  • AI-Tools im Workflow: Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deinem Design-Alltag, um Prozesse zu beschleunigen und Ideen schneller zu validieren.
  • Erfahrung im B2B Softwarebereich: Du hast dich bereits explizit mit B2B SaaS Software beschäftigt. Begriffe wie MRR, CAC, LTV sind für dich keine Fremdwörter.
  • Trendbewusstsein: Du bringst Drive mit und verfolgst die aktuellen Trends im Bereich Softwaredesign und Gestaltung.
  • Architektur- oder Planungsbüro-Umfeld: Idealerweise hast du Kenntnisse aus dem Architektur-, Ingenieur- oder Planungsbüro-Umfeld, die du im Produktdesign einbringen kannst.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse für den Austausch mit Kunden und mit unseren Teams.
  • Bonus-Skill: Hast du bereits Erfahrung mit untermStrich oder kennst du die Arbeitswelt von Architektur- und Planungsbüros? Dann ist das ein echtes Plus – aber kein Muss.


Was wir bieten

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit echtem Spielraum: Top Equipment inklusive. Idealerweise bist du 2–3 Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office, aber wenn mal eine ganze Woche remote passt, ist das kein Problem.
  • Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team: Produkt und Entwicklung arbeiten direkt miteinander. Du bist vom ersten Tag an ein fester Bestandteil des Teams – nicht Zuarbeiter, sondern Mitgestalter.
  • Wachstum, das sich anfühlt: Kein Stillstand. Herausforderungen, die dich fordern, und regelmäßiges Feedback, das dich weiterbringt.
  • Kurze Wege, echte Mitsprache: Flache Hierarchien bedeuten bei uns nicht nur weniger Meetings, sondern auch: deine Perspektive zählt, nicht dein Titel.
  • Ein Team, das sich freut, dich kennenzulernen: Offene Kultur, ehrliche Kommunikation, keine Ellenbogen.
  • Wohlatmosphäre & Team-Kultur: Modernes Büro im Herzen von Hamburg mit frischem Obst, Kaffee, gekühlten Getränken und einem gemeinsamen wöchentlichen Frühstück. 
  • Möglichkeit auf Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket & Lunch (über EDENRED/Sachbezug).


Kontakinfos

Lust, die Zukunft mitzugestalten?
Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem Lebenslauf, deinem Portfolio und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung – der Start ist ab sofort bzw. zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt möglich!

title: Senior Software Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Gridfuse
description_html:
What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.


The role

  • Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants 
  • Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour 
  • Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
  • Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
  • Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production
  • Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation 
  • Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions 
  • Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed 
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team 


What we need from you

  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems
  • You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems
  • You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes
  • You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required)
  • Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus
  • Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus
  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English


What we offer

  • Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro  
  • City center office location including home office option  
  • EGYM Wellpass membership support 
  • Educational budget for every employee 
  • Team events, summer & winter parties
  • Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team   


Sounds good to you?

Please submit your complete application including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.   

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within a couple of business days.

description_html:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Technical Project Manager (all genders) to join our PMO team as soon as possible. We embrace a remote-first approach (within Germany), but you can choose whether you’d like to work in a hybrid model or entirely on-site, depending on your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Hamburg, Cologne, Munich).


As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you are a cornerstone of strategy execution at Contabo – and you're joining at a time when a lot is moving strategically. Alongside the continued evolution of our existing cloud infrastructure, we are driving initiatives that will expand our portfolio well beyond what exists today over the coming years. This is exactly where your role comes in: embedded in our PMO, you take end-to-end ownership of technical projects across development teams and business functions – including initiatives for which no blueprint exists yet, where you help shape structures from the ground up.

You work at the intersection of technology and business: you translate sometimes still ambiguous requirements into executable plans, actively challenge requirements, and structure initiatives into scalable roadmaps, iterations, and implementation phases. In your day-to-day work, you coordinate priorities, dependencies, and delivery sequencing across multiple teams and parallel workstreams, identify resource bottlenecks and delivery risks early, and ensure transparency through structured reporting, clear governance, and effective escalation management – especially when scope and priorities shift in our fast-moving environment. You'll be working with tools like Jira, Confluence, and comparable solutions.

Beyond individual projects, you shape the PMO itself: you continuously develop our standards and processes, support portfolio alignment and prioritisation, and share your knowledge as a mentor to junior project managers. A lean PMO at Contabo means a high degree of autonomy and genuine ownership – you report directly to the Head of Strategy Execution & ESG and contribute measurably to the execution of Contabo's strategic roadmap.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project or program management within software development or technical delivery organisations
  • Proven end-to-end delivery ownership of cross-functional initiatives with multiple parallel workstreams – not limited to governance or status-reporting roles
  • Strong experience in stakeholder and escalation management
  • A high degree of ownership and composure in an environment of shifting priorities and ambiguity
  • Confident use of common PM tooling such as Jira, Confluence (or comparable)
  • Experience in a cloud, hosting, or IT infrastructure environment, as well as with agile scaling, PMO, or portfolio management (a plus)

  • Stakeholder management: You can align business partners with different perspectives around a clear roadmap and make sound prioritisation decisions.
  • Very good German skills at C1 level and English skills at C2 level are required.


What we have to offer

  • In this role, you can expect an attractive compensation package starting from €62.000
  • Join a team of Product Managers, Software Engineers, Designers, Data and Salesforce people who are excellent in their craft and are happy to share their knowledge and help you grow alongside them
  • Our team is using the latest frameworks and is working with a modern tech stack to build powerful products for our customers, craftspeople, and internal teams
  • Boost your skills with a dedicated annual learning budget to spend on conferences, courses or books 
  • Choose your own AI coding companion – we provide you with the license for the AI model or assistant of your choice 
  • We offer a challenge with purpose - the better our tech, the more people will live climate-neutral and the better the world becomes for future generations
  • We offer a fantastic culture in the tech team and beyond
    • Modern office in the heart of Berlin
    • Work from home - up to 3 days a week
    • You receive an Urban Sports Club membership & nilo.health membership
    • You can lease a job bike or bring your dog one day/week

    • 20% employer contribution to your pension and disability insurance


About us

Every application is welcome here - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion, ideology, disability, age, sexual orientation or identity. We are convinced that everyone is valuable and deserves a fair chance.

title: (Senior) AI Product Engineer (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Legalhero
description_html:
What You'll Do

You’ll identify open AI opportunities, build them from start to finish, and bring them to real users. As a Senior AI Product Engineer, you’ll work across our three product squads: You’ll single-handedly turn unaddressed topics into products, hand them off once they’re up and running, and serve as a sparring partner for the squad PMs on all AI-related topics. For us, “senior” refers to your approach to work, not your years of experience. You’ll report directly to Product Leadership.

Your Responsibilities

  • Independent AI projects (about half of your time)
  • You’ll identify high-impact AI opportunities in our legal workflows - in areas where no specific squad is responsible
  • Validation happens quickly: discussions with attorneys, Legal Ops, and insurers; prototypes built in days
  • You’ll bring the winning solutions into production yourself: routing, chaining, summarization, and agent-based loops
  • You’ll hand off mature features to the squad - complete with documentation, evaluations, and a handover plan
Support for the squads (the other half)
  • Feasibility, costs, model selection, risks: You’ll answer these questions before every AI feature is launched
  • You support the teams in designing evaluations, golden datasets, and guardrails
  • You review concepts before they go into the roadmap - including prompt injection and compliance risks (GDPR, Section 203 of the German Criminal Code)
  • You advance AI best practices: prompt engineering standards, LLM observability, and agent-based coding workflows


What you bring

Must-have

  • Multiple production-ready AI/LLM systems that you’ve shipped to real users and taken responsibility for - no prototypes
  • Demonstrable product ownership: from a vague problem to a finished product
  • Strong Python skills and a solid foundation in software engineering (Git, testing, CI/CD, code review)
  • In-depth experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or similar - including an understanding of what’s happening under the hood
  • Proficiency with LLM provider APIs: function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming
  • Evaluations, golden datasets, and guardrails before deployment
  • Solid prompt engineering - you know when to use which technique
  • Business-level English; German is a major plus due to our legal domain
Soft Skills
  • The maturity to work without a squad around you: You set your own priorities and know when to say no
  • You can explain a technical trade-off to a lawyer and a legal workflow to an engineer


What we promise

Work Environment & Flexibility

  • Office-first: 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home - with flexibility in how you structure your work
  • Modern, air-conditioned office with plenty of natural light and a large rooftop terrace overlooking Berlin
  • Central location between Gleisdreieck and Potsdamer Platz
Benefits
  • Full coverage of the public-transport ticket
  • Company pension plan with a 20% employer contribution
  • Corporate benefits platform with discounts from many brands
  • Dog-friendly office
  • Regular company and team events, after-work fun with Switch, PS5, darts, and foosball
  • Free drinks, fresh fruit, and granola
Culture & Collaboration
  • Agile mindset with open communication - every voice counts
  • Feedback is part of our culture - we believe in growing together
Fast application process
  • Your application as an AI Product Engineer (Senior) - short and to the point
  • Approx. 20-minute introductory conversation with our HR team
  • Approx. 60-minute in-person interview with your hiring manager
  • Approx. 30-minute discussion with the management team
  • A prompt job offer
Your contact: Nadine · HR Manager ·

title: Internship Go-to-Market Engineering, AI & Automation (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Autarcenergy
description_html:
Dein Impact

autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe. As we scale, we want our Go-to-Market organization to operate with the same level of automation, data quality, and product thinking as our engineering organization.


In this Internship, you will work on the technical infrastructure behind our revenue engine.


You will work directly with our Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Product teams to identify bottlenecks, build internal tools, automate workflows, connect systems, and deploy AI where it creates measurable commercial impact.


Role description

What You’ll Do

Work on our GTM operating system

  • Build the systems powering our entire customer lifecycle – from first lead to closed customer and expansion.

  • Build internal applications and workflows that help SDRs, Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and leadership make better decisions and execute faster.

  • Turn fragmented processes into scalable systems.


Automate the revenue engine

  • Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success and automate them.

  • Build automations for areas such as lead enrichment, routing, qualification, follow-ups, pipeline management, customer onboarding, and retention.

  • Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems.


Integrate AI into real workflows

  • Move AI beyond prototypes.

  • Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work.

  • Experiment rapidly with new models and tools and turn successful experiments into reliable internal products.


Build, don’t just recommend

  • You will personally implement what you design.

  • Depending on the problem, that might mean writing Python or TypeScript, building an n8n workflow, connecting an API, querying a database, prototyping an internal application, or working with our engineers on a deeper integration.

  • You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation.


Drive measurable commercial impact

  • Technology is a means, not the outcome.

  • Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

  • You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result.


Requirements

  • You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better.

  • You have strong technical skills and have worked in Python and/or TypeScript

  • You have hands-on experience building automations and integrations using tools such as n8n and APIs

  • You are comfortable working with databases, APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines

  • You are interested in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the systems behind how SAAS companies create revenue 

  • You can translate an ambiguous business problem into a technical solution without needing a detailed specification

  • You move fast, iterate, and are comfortable shipping a first version before everything is perfect

  • You are fluent in English. German or another European language is a plus


Bonus Points

  • You have first experience in a dynamic start-up environment and have worked on technical solutions

  • Tools like HubSpot, Aircall, Stripe, Intercom, PostHog, or similar platforms are not entirely new for you

  • Ideally you have worked on or build internal tools, AI agents, lead-scoring systems, enrichment pipelines, or automated outbound workflows.

  • You have worked in an early-stage or high-growth startup where speed and ownership mattered more than clearly defined responsibilities.


Was wir bieten

An internship with direct influence on how autarc scales its commercial organization.

The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure and directly collaborate with our founders and GTM leadership.

A strong engineering and product culture combined with an ambitious commercial organization.

A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person.

MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work.

Most importantly: a role where your output can directly influence how quickly autarc grows


Unsere Werte

Why autarc?

autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers.

Our platform helps installers manage the entire workflow around renewable energy projects – from lead and site assessment to technical planning, offers, documentation, installation, and ongoing operations.

We already serve more than 2,000 businesses and are expanding our platform across Europe.

As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you won’t inherit a finished system. You will help design the next generation of our commercial infrastructure.

You will work directly with leadership, have access to the entire GTM organization, and be able to ship solutions that are used by the team immediately.

No endless strategy decks. No six-month implementation projects.

Find the bottleneck. Build the solution. Measure whether it worked. Improve it.

Our next step is to expand into new countries and the UK market is next – that is why we are looking for a motivated and ambitious Intern to join our team in Berlin.



Role description

You will be working alongside the GTM Lead and the Sales team with hands out tasks around our expansion. This internship has a specific focus on sales, business development and product expansion. 

  • Hands on support of our sales team in their day-to-day work, including customer contact
  • Develop our sales decks and marketing material
  • Take part in events, fairs and customers visits on-side in the UK
  • Support the development of AI and automation tools that improve our effectiveness
The role has a 75/25 split between operational tasks & strategic topics. Anticipated starting date for this 4-6 months internship would be 1st of January 2026.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in business, economics or software engineering
  • Previous startup, consulting or VC experience
  • Fluent in English
  • Based in Berlin with a willingness to work hybrid (office in Mitte)


What we offer

  • Freedom to choose your own equipment
  • An annual team retreat
  • The choice between Dance or Deutschland Ticket for mobility 
  • Urban Sports Club for fitness
  • Regular team events, lunches and activities


Next steps

If your application is successful, you will participate in the following:

  • Screening call with someone of the sales team
  • Culture fit call with Thies (Co-Founder)
  • Take home case study (approx. 1 hour)
  • Final on-site interview with the team

title: Backend Developer (Java/Spring Boot)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Jobgether
description_html:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend Developer (Java/Spring Boot) based in Germany.

Join a fully remote product development team working on modern digital products for ambitious organizations.
You’ll build reliable backend systems, APIs, services, integrations, and database solutions using Java and Spring Boot.
Your work will contribute directly to production features, with ownership extending from implementation through testing and release.
You’ll collaborate closely with frontend, QA, DevOps, product, design, and client-side stakeholders in a cross-functional environment.
The role offers meaningful autonomy while encouraging developers to challenge assumptions, communicate risks, and understand the wider product context.
You’ll work on a project currently expected to run through February 2027, with the opportunity to apply modern engineering practices in a distributed team.
This is an excellent fit for a mid-level backend engineer who values clean code, strong collaboration, technical ownership, and continuous learning.


Accountabilities

  • Develop clean, maintainable, testable, and efficient backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.

  • Design, build, and maintain secure, reliable REST APIs and backend services for frontend applications and other systems.

  • Develop and maintain PostgreSQL database schemas, queries, indexes, migrations, data models, and persistence layers using Hibernate/JPA.

  • Translate product and business requirements into robust backend functionality and well-structured business logic.

  • Develop and maintain microservices within distributed backend architectures.

  • Implement third-party integrations, internal services, and other backend integrations based on project requirements.

  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, validation, and correct handling of edge cases.

  • Write and maintain automated tests and collaborate closely with QA engineers to ensure appropriate feature coverage.

  • Take ownership of assigned backend features from implementation through testing, release, and delivery.

  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, QA, DevOps, product managers, designers, and other backend developers to deliver complete product features.

  • Identify and communicate unclear requirements, technical risks, dependencies, and potential blockers early.

  • Participate in code reviews, pull requests, and collaborative development workflows.

  • Contribute to improving engineering practices, code quality, maintainability, and team processes.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools where appropriate to improve productivity while applying sound engineering judgment.

    • Requirements

    • 3+ years of professional backend development experience.

    • Strong practical knowledge of modern Java development; experience with Java 21 is preferred.

    • Hands-on experience building backend applications and services with Spring Boot.

    • Practical experience with Hibernate/JPA and ORM-based persistence.

    • Good knowledge of PostgreSQL, relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and query performance.

    • Experience designing, implementing, testing, and consuming RESTful APIs.

    • Practical experience with automated backend testing and a strong understanding of testing as an integral part of software development.

    • Comfortable using Git, pull requests, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.

    • Familiarity with microservices and distributed systems.

    • Experience with Domain-Driven Design or Event-Driven Architecture is a plus.

    • Familiarity with AWS or another cloud environment is advantageous, particularly experience with ECS/Fargate.

    • Experience in Fintech, SaaS, HR, Payroll, ERP, AI-enabled products, or complex enterprise platforms is beneficial.

    • Strong ownership and autonomy, with the ability to manage assigned features independently while knowing when to involve others.

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into reliable, well-structured backend solutions.

    • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or similar is a bonus.

    • Fluent professional English is required.

    • Spanish language skills are a significant advantage, particularly for collaboration with LATAM stakeholders.

    • Comfortable working remotely and organizing your schedule around required collaboration windows.

      • Benefits

      • Salary: €3,000 gross per month under a B2B contract.

      • Project duration: Project-focused engagement currently expected to run through February 2027.

      • Fully remote: Work remotely from Europe or LATAM.

      • Flexible schedule: Standard 40-hour workweek with flexibility to organize your working hours around the team’s collaboration needs.

      • Time-zone flexibility: Most working hours should overlap with the 9:00 AM–7:00 PM CET collaboration window.

      • Cross-functional environment: Work closely with backend, frontend, QA, DevOps, product, design, and client teams.

      • Autonomy: Take meaningful ownership of your work, manage responsibilities independently, and influence how solutions are delivered.

      • Modern engineering practices: Work with contemporary backend technologies, cloud infrastructure, automated testing, microservices, and AI-assisted development tools.

      • Remote collaboration: Join a distributed team with processes and tooling designed to support transparency and effective remote work.

      • Professional growth: Develop your technical and product skills through continuous collaboration, problem-solving, and exposure to diverse digital projects.

      • Collaborative culture: Work in an environment built around clarity, curiosity, growth, craftsmanship, care, and open communication.
